The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds with assistance. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

GENOPSLAG: Sagsbehandler for Børn og Unge i Upernavik
Avannaata Kommunia i Upernavik søger 1 Sagsbehandler for Børn og Unge, samt familier ved familieafdelingen til besættelse 1. september 2026 eller efter nærmere aftale.

Du vil indgå i team med andre sagsbehandlere på børn og unge- familieområdet og i offentlig hjælp områder i socialafdelingerne. Den nærmeste foresatte til sagsbehandler er Afdelingsleder for Familieafdelingen.

Arbejds- og ansvarsområder:
·Aktiv tilsyn på de forhold børn lever under i kommunen samt sagsbehandle underretninger om de tilfælde, hvor der kan være behov for hjælp.
·Modtage henvendelser, foretage samtaler og yde rådgivning, der vedrører børn og unge og deres familier.
·Vurdering af hjælpeforanstaltninger på børneområdet i henhold til de gældende lovgivning - herunder tildeling af hjælpeforanstaltninger.
·Udøve tilsyn og sagsbehandling af børn som er anbragt på døgninstitutioner eller efterskoleophold uden for kommunen, og opretholdelse af kontakt med forældre og andre pårørende til anbragte børn.
·Udarbejde indstillinger til teammøder, tværfaglige møder og ansøgninger til Socialudvalget og behandler sagerne iht. de indstillinger, som er truffet på tværfagligt samarbejdsudvalgsmødet og i henhold til de afgørelser som er truffet af Socialudvalget.
·Er sparringspartner for medarbejdere i bygdefilialer angående spørgsmål på børn og unge samt familie området.
·Så vidt muligt afløser for andre medarbejdere på børn og unge samt familie området ed behov i afdelingen.
·Deltager i den lokale socialvagtordning.
·Lave ad hoc opgaver.

Kvalifikationer:
·Socialrådgiveruddannelse eller lignende uddannelse. 
·Har vilje og interesse for at tage faglige kurser og relevante videreuddannelsesforløb.
·Erfaring med sagsbehandling på børneområdet.
·Er god til at samarbejde med kollegaer og med ledelsen.
·Er god til at efterleve organisationens- og ledelsens bestemmelser i henhold til at yde arbejds- og samarbejdsindsats som sagsbehandler i Socialforvaltningen.
·Har erfaring med at etablere et godt samarbejde med eksterne samarbejdspartnere, såvel i form af teammøder eller under tværfagligt møde eller tværsektorielt.
·Er foregangseksempel, god til klientkontakt og kommunikation.
·Er psykisk robust og god til at håndtere konflikter.
·Er systematisk, pålidelig, loyal og ansvarsbevist.
·Er stabil og omhyggeligt.

Målet for stillingen på den korte sigt er at bidrage til bedre kvalitet af sagsbehandling herunder undersøgelser og valg af hensigtsmæssige hjælpeforanstaltninger iht. børn og unge samt familieområdet.

Målet for langt sigt er, at bidrage til reduktion af især grove tilfælde af omsorgssvigt af børn og unge, psykisk og fysisk vold, herunder seksuelle krænkelser, samt styrke forældrenes forældreevne.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår vil ske efter gældende overenskomst med den til enhver gældende forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation.

Der kan til stillingen ikke anvises bolig.

Nærmere oplysning om stillingen kan indhentes ved henvendelse til Afdelingsleder for Familieafdeling Uthilie Thomassen Løvstrøm på telefon 70 18 00 eller pr. e-mail: uthl@avannaata.gl

Ansøgning samt dokumenter m.v sendes via Avannaata Kommunias hjemmeside avannaata/ledige-stillinger.

title: Director, Legal Operations
description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you'll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We're big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits.

For this high functioning team, the nature of the work benefits from frequent in-office presence, and employees may be expected to work from a company office up to four days per week. While we remain committed to flexibility, this team's rhythm includes regular in-person connection to support collaboration, learning, and impact.

The Legal Department provides core legal support to all Dolby functions, runs several IP-centric businesses, and leads government relations.

The Director of Legal Operations is a strategic leader responsible for enabling a high-performing, data-driven, and technology-enabled Legal organization. This role oversees the operational infrastructure supporting Dolby's global Legal organization and partners closely with executive leaders across Legal, Finance, IT, People & Places, Security, and business functions.

The Director will lead a team of legal operations professionals and serve as a catalyst for operational excellence, transformation, and organizational effectiveness. This role will drive the Legal department's strategy, planning, communications, technology roadmap, vendor management, knowledge management capabilities.

A critical aspect of this role is identifying, implementing, and scaling emerging technologies, including generative AI and legal-specific artificial intelligence solutions, to enhance productivity, improve decision-making, reduce risk, and enable the department to focus on higher-value work.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of operational rigor, business acumen, change leadership, and demonstrated success leveraging technology and AI to transform legal service delivery in a complex global environment.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing legal operations team.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
  • Build organizational capability in legal technology, process improvement, analytics, and AI adoption.

Strategic Planning & Transformation

  • Partner with Legal leadership to define and execute the department's long-term strategic roadmap.
  • Drive change management initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness, scalability, and employee experience.
  • Establish annual objectives, key results, metrics, and operational priorities aligned with business goals.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts across legal processes, services, and operating models.

AI, Automation & Technology Innovation

  • Develop and lead the Legal organization's technology and AI strategy.
  • Identify, evaluate, implement, and govern legal technology platforms, including contract lifecycle management, e-billing, matter management, intellectual property systems, document automation, knowledge management, and AI-enabled legal solutions.
  • Champion responsible adoption of generative AI tools and workflows to improve efficiency, knowledge retrieval, contract review, legal research, matter management, drafting, and reporting.
  • Establish governance, risk management, security, compliance, and ethical use frameworks for AI-enabled legal technologies.
  • Partner with IT, Security, and Privacy teams to ensure legal technology solutions meet enterprise standards.
  • Monitor emerging legal technology and AI trends and recommend innovative solutions that create measurable business value.

Operational Excellence

  • Design and implement scalable processes, policies, and operating procedures that improve efficiency, service quality, and risk management across the Legal function.
  • Create and maintain operational frameworks that support a growing global legal organization.
  • Lead departmental planning, resource allocation, and operational governance activities.

Financial & Vendor Management

  • Partner with Business Operations to oversee the Legal department's budget, forecasting, accrual management, and financial planning processes, including identifing cost optimization opportunities and improve spend transparency.
  • Manage outside counsel and legal service providers, including selection, performance oversight, fee negotiations, billing guideline compliance, and vendor governance.
  • Implement data-driven approaches to managing legal spend and maximizing return on external resources.

Knowledge Management & Productivity

  • Lead enterprise-class knowledge management initiatives that improve access to legal expertise, templates, policies, playbooks, and institutional knowledge.
  • Implement AI-enabled knowledge discovery and content management capabilities that improve attorney productivity and consistency.
  • Promote standardization and reuse of legal resources across the global organization.

Employee Engagement

  • Lead Legal department employee engagement initiatives, and large-scale organizational events, including all-employee meetings, leadership forums, and global summits.
  • Ensure employees are informed, aligned, and connected to department priorities and business objectives.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build strong partnerships across Legal, Finance, IT, Security, Procurement, People & Places, and business organizations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on operational strategy, technology investments, AI adoption, and organizational effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, Legal Studies, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Legal Operations, Legal Technology, Contract Administration, or related functions.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience managing high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading legal operations within a complex, global, publicly traded organization.
  • Direct experience implementing and scaling legal technology platforms, including CLM, e-billing, matter management, intellectual property systems, knowledge management tools, or similar technologies.
  • Proven experience evaluating, implementing, and driving adoption of AI-enabled solutions within legal, compliance, or corporate functions.
  • Strong understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, data privacy, information security, and regulatory considerations affecting legal technology.
  • Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets, vendor relationships, and outside counsel programs.
  • Strong analytical, financial, project management, and change leadership skills.
  • Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • J.D., MBA, or other advanced degree.
  • Certification in Legal Operations, Project Management, Process Improvement, or Change Management.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives.
  • Deep familiarity with generative AI platforms, legal AI solutions, workflow automation technologies, and emerging legal technology trends.

title: Travel Coordinator
description:
Company Description

Working at The Adaptavist Group

The Adaptavist Group is a global family of companies with a common goal. We combine the best of teamwork, technology, and processes, helping all kinds of businesses be better today and tomorrow.

We are experts at delivering enterprise software, tailored solutions, and quality services across some of the world’s most trusted technology ecosystems, including Atlassian, AWS, Slack, GitLab, monday.com and Aha!

We make change happen. From anywhere.

What we offer you

We offer a very generous holiday (PTO) allowance, trusting you to take vacation time that suits your personal life, alongside flexible working hours that empower you to work when it best fits you and your team. We provide MacBooks to all employees and additional support for fully remote workers to set up their home offices.

Our exceptional Time Away Policy includes 26 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents, 13 weeks for non-birthing parents, and extended leave for adoption, IVF, surrogacy, elective egg freezing, and women's health needs such as menopause, menstruation, endometriosis, and PCOS.

Our trusting, flexible, remote-first way of working means that work can fit around your life, rather than your life fitting around work.

Read our full list of benefits

Job Description

As Travel Co-ordinator, this person will be responsible for ensuring all travel bookings.

They will be responsible for the booking and issuing of all work-related travel for 500+ employees and as such must feel comfortable with multitasking, challenging travel requests and presenting alternative options to travellers where there is a more cost-effective solution than that brief.

Multi-tasking and time responsiveness are essential for this role. The successful candidate must be able to adapt and juggle multiple tasks and personalities on a daily basis and importantly, do it well and at speed. They must be able to manage their own workload and prioritise tasks. This role is suitable for someone who keeps calm in busy travel periods, has a can-do attitude and is a fast and efficient worker. The successful candidate will be bright, personable and on the ball. They are tasked with a very important role and are in charge of a lot of money. As such, this person must also possess excellent numeracy skills.

This person will also be responsible for cross-checking and managing all invoicing and data entry related to travel, so it is essential that the successful candidate is organised when it comes to finances and trackers.

The workload varies daily. Some days are hectic, and some can be quieter. During quieter periods, proactivity is expected in this role, whether checking that all shared documents are up to date or keeping hotel registers up to date.

The role may involve working AM/PM shifts to provide travel support coverage between 7:00am and 10:00pm. The team will coordinate shift patterns, with a crossover period for handover and team updates.

Key responsibilities and accountabilities

  • Book and issue travel bookings on behalf of passengers.
  • Provide booking confirmations to the passenger and ensure everything is in place for the traveller.
  • Tracks travel spending
  • Excellent computer literacy (Gsuite)
  • Excellent typing and concise communication skills. Telephone and email manners of the highest calibre.
  • Easy communication with EAs
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Travel Team Lead

Qualifications

Essential

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency in Gsuite or other productivity software.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new technology and processes.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.
  • Prepared to work outside of standard working hours when projects and events demand it
  • Willingness to travel domestically or internationally for business purposes.
  • Comfortable working AM/PM shifts to support coverage between 7:00am and 10:00pm when required.

Desirable

  • GDS trained
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Additional Information

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At TAG, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet.

Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What to expect

We have published some support on Interviewing with The Adaptavist Group to try to alleviate any pre-interview anxieties, here you’ll find information to help you prepare and ace an interview at TAG.

You can read them here

Equal opportunities for everyone

At The Adaptavist Group, we are committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community and believe this positively impacts both the creation of our innovative products and our delivery of bespoke solutions to our global customers and our own unique culture. We encourage all qualified applicants, regardless of age, disability, race, sexual orientation, religion or belief, sex, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, marriage, and civil partnership status.

Recruitment fraud notice

We are aware of recruitment scams where individuals or organisations may falsely claim to represent us. We take this seriously and are committed to protecting candidates throughout our hiring process.

We will never ask for any form of payment, fees, or financial commitment at any stage of recruitment, including applications, interviews, onboarding, or equipment provision.

Most of our recruitment communications are sent from our system, SmartRecruiters, and may come from addresses such as @smartrecruiters.com. All our emails are signed off by The Talent Team @ The Adaptavist Group.

If you are ever unsure about the authenticity of a message or job offer, please verify it via our official careers channels before responding.

title: Senior MH-139 Utility Helicopter Program Manager
description:
Senior MH-139 Utility Helicopter Program Manager

Company:

The Boeing Company

The Boeing Defense Space & Security (BDS) Vertical Lift Division has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager, MH-139 Utility Helicopter Program Manager position located in Ridley Park, PA! This role will be accountable for the execution and growth of the MH-139 Utility Helicopter program by developing organization and plans that meet the BDS Strategy by modeling Boeing values and behaviors.

The BDS Vertical Lift Division portfolio is critical to defense around the world and is responsible for manufacturing the most advanced military rotorcraft in the world and is renowned for leading-edge solutions that deliver proven capabilities. With 60 years of expertise and a global fleet over 2,500 strong — comprising the AH-6 Little Bird, AH-64 Apache, V-22 Osprey and H-47 Chinook aircraft and in-development entrants, including the MH-139A Grey Wolf — Boeing advances missions ranging from precision attack and reconnaissance to medium and heavy lift operations.

This is a rewarding and challenging leadership role that reports directly to the Senior Vice President of Vertical Lift and as the Program Manager, will be responsible for securing resources and strategies to meet the commitments of the MH-139 program, as well as capturing opportunities for growth and fostering relationships and partnerships to expand the portfolio. The individual should have an innovative and strategic mindset, proactively seeking opportunities to enhance program performance and growth potential. Expect frequent engagement with executive leadership, senior officials, partners and customers.

Successful candidate will lead the MH-139 Program to deliver critical Vertical Lift capabilities to the United States Air Force as part of the UH-1N Replacement Program and has established itself as an affordable and capable Utility Helicopter Commercial Derivative platform for Domestic and International Customers.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Manages and develops the leadership team of the MH-139 Program and supports organization by fostering a culture that models Boeing values and behaviors.
  • Develops and executes integrated organizational plans, develops business strategies to meet all program financial objectives and priorities aligned with BDS strategy.
  • Establish and further develop relationships and partnerships with customers, suppliers, internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensures accountability and help needed is addressed to meet program commitments.
  • Leads major negotiations with Customer and Partners to ensure strategic alignment and resolution of critical program issues.
  • Supports business capture opportunities and identifies program growth potential.
  • Supports Business Unit and Division level operating rhythm and communication by ensuring appropriate leadership engagement.

Basic Qualification for Manager, M Level (Required Skills/Experience):

  • 10+ years of experience leading through influence and partnering with cross-functional teams on programs or projects
  • 10+years of experience leading complex integrated business operations including engineering, production, services, supply chain, and quality.
  • 10+ years of experience with developing and managing strong relationships with internal & external partners, government customers and representatives
  • Demonstrated strong Program Management leadership skills driving successful execution
  • Demonstrated strong experience using Program Management Best Practices
  • 5+ years of Senior Leader or Senior Manager experience

Preferred Qualifications (Desired skills/Experience):

  • Strong communication skills & ability to interface with senior level executives
  • Experience managing DOD programs, DOD acquisition cycle, business capture, and Foreign Military Sales (FMS).

Conflict of interest:

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Relocation: This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Travel: This position is expected to be available to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% of the time.

Drug Free Workplace:

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

Total Rewards:

At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

The Boeing 401(k) helps you save for your future, with contributions from Boeing that can help you grow your retirement savings. Our best-in-class retirement benefit features:

Best in class 401(k) plan: we'll match your contributions dollar for dollar, up to 10% of eligible pay with immediate 100% vesting

Student Loan Match: The Boeing 401(k) Student Loan Match allows eligible enrolled U.S. employees to have their qualified student loan debt payments counted, along with any match-eligible contributions they make, for purposes of determining the Company Match to employees' Boeing 401(k) accounts.

Summary pay range:

$218,450 - $295,550

Language Requirements:

Not Applicable

Education:

Not Applicable

Relocation:

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Export Control Requirement:

This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

Safety Sensitive:

This is not a Safety Sensitive Position.

Security Clearance:

This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.

Visa Sponsorship:

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Contingent Upon Award Program

This position is not contingent upon program award

title: Insights Associate Program Manager
description:
This position is based in Chicago, IL

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

At LinkedIn, we empower professionals worldwide to achieve more. Every day, millions of people rely on our products to connect, discover opportunities, and gain actionable insights. The Insights Associate Program Manager role is pivotal in delivering scalable, data-driven solutions that drive LinkedIn’s success and enable customers to unlock value through our products within the Talent Solutions business.

This role sits at the unique intersection of LinkedIn product expertise, proprietary dataset ownership, and alignment with customer lifecycle and go-to-market strategies. They blend technical program management, analytical problem-solving, and collaboration to produce insights and strategies built on trust and innovation.

About The Role

As an Insights Associate Program Manager, you will perform technical work, ensuring the insights and strategic recommendations you develop meet high standards of quality, reliability, and scalability. From coding sophisticated queries to shaping strategic narratives, you will play a critical role in translating LinkedIn’s data into actionable insights for internal and external stakeholders.

Your efforts will contribute to the optimization and creation of tools, narratives, and strategies that enhance LinkedIn’s ability to solve customer challenges, improve decision-making, and elevate the value proposition of our Talent Solutions portfolio.

Responsibilities

Data-Driven Insights Development

Leverage LinkedIn’s proprietary datasets to design and deliver impactful, scalable insights that align with product and lifecycle strategies in addressing customer pain points and value propositions.

Write and optimize code (e.g., SQL, Python, Spark SQL) to extract, process, and analyze

data. Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate query development,

debug pipelines, and prototype analyses faster — while applying sound judgment to

validate outputs for accuracy.

Build and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows using tools like Apache Airflow and HD.

Collaboration and Alignment

Partner with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Data Science, to refine messaging and enhance customer value delivery anchored in data.

Establish strong stakeholder relationships, serving as a technical and strategic advisor for internal and external partners on program strategy.

Insights Strategy and Vision

Define and execute the long-term vision and roadmap for your programs.

Identify gaps in existing tools and customer lifecycle motions, prioritize opportunities, and drive alignment on strategic initiatives.

Provide recommendations on opportunities to strengthen strategy for business impact based on LinkedIn data for prioritized segments, markets, and initiatives.

Measure the effectiveness of Insights driven interventions across our customer lifecycle and field partner touchpoints, tracking its impact on LinkedIn’s Talent business outcomes.

Visualization and Communication

Develop compelling visualizations and narratives using Tableau or equivalent tools to communicate insights.

Present findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, fostering trust and engagement.

Data Quality and Governance

Implement data quality checks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity.

Document best practices, compliance protocols, and technical solutions for scalability.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree.

3+ years of experience in data analysis, consulting, or technical program management.

3+ years of experience with SQL, with experience in optimizing queries for performance (Trino, Spark SQL preferred).

2+ years of creating data visualizations and data storytelling to turn data into Insights using Tableau or similar program.

Preferred Qualifications

BA/BS degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science or related quantitative field.

Experience communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences to ensure alignment and foster engagement.

Experience with product, marketing, or customer lifecycle analytics, including the ability to tie insights to business outcomes.

Experience building and nurturing relationships with senior stakeholders and serving as a trusted advisor and technical expert.

Experience writing and optimizing Python scripts for data analysis, automation, and scalable workflows.

Practical business understanding with genuine passion for technology, big data, and/or artificial intelligence.

Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder programs and influence without authority.

Strong problem-solving, business acumen, and communication skills.

Suggested Skills

Technical Expertise: Strong coding and data management skills. Motivated by curiosity with genuine interest in learning new technology and skills.

Program Management: Proven ability to run operational program coordination, track timelines, and execute in fast-paced environments.

Business & Lifecycle Alignment: Ability to connect technical solutions to customer lifecycle stages and overall business needs.

Collaboration: High EQ and ability to build relationships across diverse teams.

Trust and Integrity: Commitment to delivering accurate, actionable insights that stakeholders can rely on.

Agility & Adaptability: Adapts readily to changing priorities and business needs, staying effective and solutions-oriented under pressure.

LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The pay range for this role is $89,000 to $145,000. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits, and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We seek candidates with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. LinkedIn considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

LinkedIn is committed to offering an inclusive and accessible experience for all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. Our goal is to foster an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone has the opportunity to be successful.

If you need a Reasonable Accommodation to search for a job opening, apply for a position, or participate in the interview process, connect with us and describe the specific Accommodation requested for a disability-related limitation.
Fill out an Accommodation request here: https://app.smartsheet.com/b/form/b660a0327d044969abfd7a4e73d15c36

  • Documents in alternate formats or read aloud to you

  • Being accompanied by a service dog

A request for an accommodation will be responded to within three business days. However, non-disability related requests, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by LinkedIn, or (c) consistent with LinkedIn's legal duty to furnish information.

title: Product Manager | South Cone
description:
Headquarters: Buenos Aires | Remote

At EBANX, we believe barriers were made to be broken. We started our story in Curitiba, Brazil, and today we are a global company, present in more than 29 countries, with offices in Curitiba, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Johannesburg. In total, we are 700+ ebankers spread across the world, connecting companies like Uber, Netflix, Spotify, TikTok, Canva, Shopee, Meta, and Shein to millions of consumers in emerging markets—creating new opportunities and revolutionizing the future of digital payments.

Our mission is clear: to give global access to everyone. We are guided by the motto #TamoJunto, which translates into four key pillars: Shape Tomorrow, Evolve Fast, Make It Happen, and Unlock The World.

If you want to be part of a global company with accelerated growth that is shaping the future of digital payments, EBANX is the place for you.

At EBANX’s Product team you don’t just create features. You develop user-centered solutions that transform the experience of millions of consumers and global companies. Every product decision you make has a real impact on the future of digital payments, combining strategic vision, innovation, and collaboration to make our work truly Out Of The Ordinary.

As a Product Manager you will be responsible for the strategy, performance, and evolution of EBANX’s local payment solutions in the South Cone region. You will act as the owner of the product — defining its vision, driving its adoption, and ensuring its success in the market. This is a high-impact role that combines product strategy, commercial alignment, discovery, and delivery execution.You'll lead the expansion and optimization of our local payment solutions in Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Bolivia, connecting the dots between merchant needs, business priorities, and market opportunities. You will work at the intersection of strategy and execution, owning the product from discovery to adoption, ensuring EBANX continues to lead in the digital payments landscape.
Your day-to-day impact:
  • Define the product vision and long-term strategy for payment solutions in the South Cone region, aligned with merchant needs and EBANX’s strategic goals;
  • Act as the voice of the product across the organization, connecting local market dynamics with global product direction;
  • Lead product discoveries to deeply understand customer pain points, competitive landscape, and opportunities for innovation;
  • Partner with commercial, operations, finance, marketing, legal, and engineering to develop and deliver scalable, compliant and high-impact solutions;
  • Manage the full product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery to go-to-market, enablement, and post-launch iteration;
  • Develop the go-to-market strategy for new features or payment methods, including training, positioning, and performance tracking;
  • Monitor product performance (TPV, revenue, costs, margins) and identify levers for growth, optimization, and differentiation;
  • Build business cases to prioritize initiatives and support strategic decision-making;
Must-haves to shine in this role:
  • Proven experience in product management or product strategy, ideally in payments, fintech, or high-growth tech companies;
  • Solid understanding of the payment ecosystem (issuers, acquirers, APMs, schemes, PSPs, settlement, FX, regulations);
  • Strong business acumen — ability to connect product decisions to revenue, cost efficiency, and market impact;
  • Fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus;
  • Experience working cross-functionally in a global and multicultural environment;
  • Hands-on experience with product discovery, market research, stakeholder alignment, and backlog management;
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to drive consensus and influence across teams;
Bonus points if you have:
  • Experience leading local payment strategy in Latin American markets, especially in the South Cone region;
  • Deep knowledge of payments ecosystem in LATAM;
  • Ability to translate complexity into clarity — whether in a sales pitch, a product doc, or a roadmap update;
  • Track record of successfully launching and scaling payment solutions;
  • Passion for digital commerce, innovation, and building products that solve real merchant problems;

EBANX offers:

  • Performance Bonus: Annual bonus program based on company results.
  • EBANX Education: Financial assistance for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs to support your professional growth.
  • EBANX Skills: Dedicated budget for courses, certifications, and workshops to encourage continuous learning.
  • Language Classes: Language classes to support your personal and professional development.
  • Health & Well-being: Medical and dental plans with extensive coverage, including support for dependents and wellness programs.
    Flexible Work Culture: Semi-flexible hours, additional day off on your birthday, and year-end break to support work-life balance.
  • Well-being Program: Access to activities and resources that promote physical and mental health.

#LI-TC1

Learn more about our #ebanxlife on LinkedIn and Instagram, and see what it’s like to be part of a global team that breaks barriers, creates opportunities, and celebrates every achievement together.

An Out Of The Ordinary career is waiting for you here!

title: PCT- FT
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

This position performs nonprofessional direct and indirect patient care activities including personal, physical and comfort needs of patients, under the supervision of a registered professional nurse. This position will provide high-quality patient care in coordination with licensed medical staff.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. High School Diploma or equivalent.

2. Obtain certification in Basic Life Support within 30 days of hire date.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EXPERIENCE:

1. Prior patient care experience.

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Observes and reports all patient concerns/changes in condition to a registered nurse immediately.

2. Assists the Registered Nurse with admission, transfer, discharge and general patient care duties.

3. Records the vital signs, assists in personal hygiene and other patient comfort measures. Records oral intake and outputs (temperature, blood pressure and other monitoring).

4. Assists in specimen collection and other activities of assigned patients.

5. Assists in indirect patient care by maintaining a clean and safe environment to help prevent and/or control infections and to provide for safety of patients, visitors and employees.

6. Reports all necessary equipment repairs to appropriate personnel according to departmental procedure in a timely manner.

7. Prepares patients for examinations and diagnostic procedures according to departmental procedure.

8. Communicates with RN regarding any nutrition issues, such as poor appetite or verbalized lack of understanding of diet changes.

10. Assists department with administrative tasks to support the department operations.

11. Answers patient call bell and relays message to appropriate personnel

For facilities with specialty accreditation requirements:

1. Completion of annual required education related to specialty accreditation as defined by accreditation standards. Training may be completed through CBLs, trainings, In-services, and competency validation.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Heavy/Hard Work: Work requires strength and/or stamina, lifting, moving, stooping, reaching, standing, and walking.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Working closely with others.

2. Working protracted or irregular hours.

3. Working around biohazards.

4. Working around infectious diseases.

5. Working with or near the deceased.

Du har god finmotorik og en rolig hånd, materialet er porøst og skal behandles varsomt.

Erfaring fra produktion er en fordel, men ikke et krav, det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære.

title: Collision Technician
description:
Jeff Gordon Chevrolet Collision CenterLocation: 228 S College Road, Wilmington, North Carolina 28403-1610


Summary: Responsible for identifying and performing necessary body repair work in accordance with factory and Collision Center specifications.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This job has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

  • Examines body damage on customer vehicles
  • Identifies necessary body repair work
  • Estimates cost of body work
  • Requests necessary parts
  • Performs body repairs including removing damaged body parts and replacing with fixed or new parts
  • Documents repairs performed
  • Performs body repairs efficiently and according to Collision Center and insurance company guidelines
  • Maintains CSI at or above Company standards
  • Maintains an organized, clean and safe work area
  • Participates in required training
  • Records all hours worked accurately in company timekeeping system
  • Follows Safeguards rules and regulations.
  • Demonstrates the Company’s Core Values.
  • Complies with Company policies and procedures.
  • Observes all Federal, State, Local and Company safety rules and regulations in the performance of duties.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with medical conditions to perform the essential functions.

Desired Education:

High School Diploma

Desired Work Experience: 5+ years

Certificates and Licenses:

Driver’s License

Attendance Expectations:

The position requires regular and predictable attendance at the Dealership. Scheduled shifts may include evening hours, weekends, and holidays. Position is not remote due to essential job functions.

Education/Experience:

Thorough knowledge of automotive parts and systems. Demonstrable mechanical skills and knowledge. Technical training or commensurate technical experience required.

Reasoning Ability:

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions. Ability to deal with standardized situations. Ability to understand and follow technical manuals. Strong problem-solving skills to identify and request necessary parts, and perform repairs efficiently while adhering to dealership and manufacturer guidelines.

Verbal and Writing Ability:

Ability to read and comprehend instructions, correspondence, and memos. Ability to use communication skills to clearly explain vehicle issues, repair needs, and recommendations to team members, service advisors, and customers. Proficient writing skills to accurately document services performed, parts requested, and any issues identified, ensuring clear and thorough records in the dealership's system.

Computer Skills:

Proficient in using dealership software systems to document vehicle services, track repair history, and manage timekeeping. Capable of navigating the parts department inventory and ordering system to request necessary parts efficiently, and able to utilize technology to ensure accurate documentation of repairs and maintenance.

Math Ability:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide. Proficiency in using measurements to assess parts and ensure proper fitting during repairs and maintenance.

Environment Demands:

Duties are performed primarily in the service area. Work includes movement around vehicles, working in various physical positions, and the safe operation of power tools and test equipment. May be exposed to loud noise, vibration, exhaust fumes, and other service and repair conditions. Frequently interacts with customers, service advisors and the service manager.

Communication Skills:

Ability to clearly communicate with customers and team members to accurately diagnose issues, explain repair needs, and provide updates on vehicle status. Must be able to follow detailed service instructions and relay any necessary information about repairs, maintenance, or parts requirements to ensure efficient workflow and customer satisfaction.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

  • Lifting & Carrying: Frequently lift, carry, push, and pull objects weighing up to 50 pounds; occasionally maneuver heavy vehicle components, equipment, or parts exceeding 50 pounds with the assistance of mechanical lifting devices
  • Standing & Movement: Stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday on hard surfaces such as concrete; frequently bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and crawl to access vehicle undercarriages, wheel wells, and low-clearance areas
  • Reaching & Working Positions: Reach overhead, below the knee, and at shoulder level; work in confined spaces, awkward positions, and at various heights when accessing different vehicle areas
  • Hand & Wrist Use: Continuously use hands and fingers to grip, handle, feel, and manipulate tools, equipment, spray guns, and vehicle components; perform repetitive hand and wrist motions throughout the shift
  • Vision: Maintain close, distance, color, depth perception, and peripheral vision to accurately assess vehicle damage, match paint colors, and ensure quality of repairs
  • Sensory: Must be able to talk and hear, including wearing hearing protection as required; ability to detect odors related to chemicals, paints, and vehicle fluids
  • Physical Stamina: Sustain physical activity throughout an entire shift, which may include extended hours; safely work in a fast-paced environment with exposure to noise, fumes, and varying temperature

Core Values:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following Core Values:

Servant Leadership

Servant Leaders consciously put the needs of others before their own, because to serve people is to value them.

Teamwork through Trust & Respect

Diversity is strength, and when we trust and respect one another we can work as a team to achieve at a high level.

Integrity

Being honest and transparent with people, in an effort to do the right thing within the letter and spirit of the law, drives every action we take and every decision we make.

Commitment to Customer Enthusiasm

Every day we recommit ourselves to the customer experience, and we are empowered to exceed the expectations of our customers.

Passion for Winning

Hendrick’s tradition of winning is based on the idea of striving to be the best, not the biggest, and is therefore defined by how we treat our people.

Accountability at All Levels

Taking ownership of our actions and our decisions allows us to grow as individuals, and support each other as a team.

Commitment to Continuous Improvement

Every day we soften our hearts as well as our egos, in order to seek out and improve upon areas of opportunity within ourselves and our team.

The employee will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other duties and responsibilities upon the request of a supervisor. This job description is subject to revision at the discretion of the company.

description:

This position has the authority, responsibility, and shift accountability for the delivery of nursing care through the use of the nursing process. The incumbent accepts accountability, applies competent clinical knowledge skills, and uses independent nursing judgment for care provided by self and by health care providers to whom care is delegated to achieve quality patient care outcomes.

The incumbent must demonstrate the knowledge and skills at the novice level necessary to provide care that is relevant to the patient(s) under their care, as well as apply principles of growth and development over the life span. The incumbent also must possess the ability to assess and interpret patient data needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to his or her age-specific needs. This role provides professional nursing care for patients in an inpatient hospital setting.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Current Registered Nurse license issued by the state in which services will be provided or current multi-state Registered Nurse license through the enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact (eNLC).

2. Obtain certification in Basic Life Support within 30 days of hire date.

EXPERIENCE:

1. Less than 12 months of experience as a registered nurse.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Bachelors of Science in Nursing Degree (BSN).

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Demonstrates safety and continuity of care using methods such as documentation, handoff tools/processes, etc.

2. Demonstrates ability to create plan of care using the nursing process: assessment, diagnoses, intervention, and evaluation of outcomes.

3. Recognizes patient safety concerns through appropriate resources.

4. Provides education based on unique learning needs of patient.

5. Incorporates patient individuality & mutuality data in delivery of care.

6. Performs an adequate patient assessment and documentation.

7. Demonstrates teach-back method to evaluate effectiveness of education.

8. Utilizes Evidence-Based Practice (EBP) in nursing care.

9. Participates in organizational patient-centered care model.

10. Documents problems and issues in the plan of care.

11. Demonstrates growth in ability to care for more complex patients utilizing consultation with experienced colleagues.

12. Demonstrates a commitment to lifelong learning through self-reflection and inquiry for learning and personal growth.

13. Retains accountability for delegated nursing care.

14. Recognizes scope of practice for all interprofessional team members.

15. Participates in holistic, culturally sensitive data collection.

16. Assesses the impact of family dynamics on healthcare consumer health and wellness.

17. Integrates the American Nursing Association (ANA)’s code of ethics to guide nursing practice.

18. Identifies discriminatory health care practices in culturally diverse populations.

19. Individualizes care based on beliefs, barriers, and readiness to learn of patients.

For facilities with specialty accreditation requirements:

1. Completion of annual required education related to specialty accreditation as defined by accreditation standards. Training may be completed through CBLs, trainings, In-services, and competency validation.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. The National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health recommends minimizing the need for employees to manually lift patients, and limit safe patient handling to 35 pounds. All transfers, lifts and re-positioning will be completed utilizing the lift equipment and/or other patient handling aids as indicated by the patient’s profile and appropriate algorithms.

2. Heavy/Hard work: Work requires strength and/or stamina, lifting, moving, stooping, reaching, standing, walking, and carrying of materials and equipment weighing 40+lbs.

3. Visual acuity must be within normal range.

4. Hearing within normal range is required (i.e. to assess breath sounds, bowel sounds, apical pulse, monitors, etc.)

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Working protracted or irregular hours.

2. Working around biohazards.

3. Working around infectious diseases.

4. Working with or near the deceased.

5. Working with hands in water.

6. Working with electrical hazards associated with patient care equipment.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

1. Possesses the interpersonal skills to positively and effectively communicate, negotiate, and resolve conflict.

2. Uses competent clinical practice and critical thinking skills to efficiently deliver patient care with all health care providers while maximizing efficient use of resources.

3. Ability to be flexible in response to changes in work volume, staff and scheduling changes.

4. Ability to work successfully under highly stressful conditions and capable of adapting to varying workloads and work assignments on a constant basis.

The CAPE program is a system-wide clinical advancement program (clinical ladder) to enhance professional development, provide a reward system for quality clinical performance, promote quality nursing, and improve job satisfaction for inpatient direct care nurses.

To apply for the next level, the CAPE nurse must meet the requirements of their current level. They must also meet the required years of nursing experience, degree, and certification to apply for the next level. In addition, nurses who are approved for levels 3, 4, 5, or 6 must complete and submit five competencies on an annual basis to maintain their current level.

Level 1

  • No experience required
  • All graduate nurses with less than 12 months of experience enter at Level one with a diploma, ADN, BSN, or higher

Level 2

  • Meets requirements for previous level
  • One year of experience.

Level 3

  • Meets requirements for previous levels
  • Two years of experience, plus one specialty certification
  • Certification is Preferred but not required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students

Level 4

  • Available to those with a BSN or higher or nurses with ADN/diploma with 5 years of experience
  • one specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and/or shared governance at the unit level

Level 5

  • Available to those with an MSN or higher with 4 years of experience, or nurses with a BSN with 4 years of experience and a health-related Master’s Degree, or nurses with a BSN and 5 years of experience
  • One specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and shared governance at the organization level

Level 6

  • Available to those with an MSN or higher degree with 7 or more years of experience. Consideration is given to other health-related advanced degrees that would assist with direct patient care at the bedside
  • One specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and shared governance at the system level

description:

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

Posted Job Title

Clinical Research Program Manager

Job Profile Title

Clinical Research Program Manager B

Job Description Summary

Working in partnership with the Director of Clinical Research of the Center for Cytokine Storm Treatment and Laboratory (CSTL), the Program Manager oversees all Castleman disease (CD) clinical research programs, specifically including the CD ACCELERATE natural history registry and CD biobank, Castlebank. The Program Manager will be key to the strategic planning and establishment of the CSTL, which will integrate clinical, research, educational and patient advocacy operations. The Program Manager will be engaged in the oversight of data acquisition and research execution of the ACCELERATE natural history registry and biobank studies.

Job Description

The Program Manager will ensure that the protocols, SOPs, regulatory guidelines, GCP, and all best practices are followed rigorously. The Program manager will work closely with major internal (PI, data coordinators, researcher, laboratory technician, students, Institutional Review Board (IRB), etc.) and external (pharmaceutical collaborators, non-profit partners, external collaborators, oversight boards, CROs, Subcontractors, etc.) stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance, completion of project milestones, and completion of all reporting requirements, and correct allocation of resources.

Strategic planning and oversight by the Program Manager will be critical to the successful establishment of the ACCELERATE Natural History Registry and Castlebank. It is essential that the Program Manager has experience with research planning, operations, and project management. Another important component of the Program Manager is managing oversight of a clinical trial, which includes assisting with recruitment, patient visits, blood draws, documentation, data entry, and IRB submissions. They will directly manage the research team (2 data analysts whose hiring is expected plus part-time and student workers , one registry coordinator, and one biobank assistant).

This position will also participate in the quality auditing and database management of ACCELERATE and Biobank studies. The Program Manager will also manage the database, perform quality auditing and adverse event reporting, and work with the UPenn IRB and foreign Ethics Committees in accordance with protocol requirements. The Program Manager will coordinate the preparation and submission of regulatory documents (including continuing reviews, amendments, and adverse event reporting) to the IRB and other regulatory institutions. They will help with the orientation, training and supervision of data analysts, coordinators, and student workers.

Position contingent to funding

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree with 5-7 years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.

Master’s degree in a health-related discipline plus 3-5 years relevant clinical research experience preferred. Hematology/oncology, immunology, clinical trial, and registry study experience is preferred.

Strong organizational skills; experience conducting studies in one or more of the above content areas preferred; excellent verbal and written communication skills essential to enable working with multiple members of research team; must be highly skilled in MS Word and Excel applications, understand medical records/patient charts organization and terminology.

Strong management and leadership skills essential.

Additional experience in clinical research is a plus. The appropriate candidate will possess a thorough knowledge of Federal Regulations, GCP and IND/IDE in research. Must understand regulatory affairs and their applications to Quality Control and Quality Assurance; understand the application of federal, local and institutional regulations as they apply to the conduct of human subjects research. Position requires effective problem solving abilities; must be able to multi-task and prioritize; a strong work ethic; ability to work as part of a team, as well as independently; and excellent organizational and time management skills.

Demonstrated ability to effectively present complex information is required.

Job Location - City, State

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

Department / School

Perelman School of Medicine

Pay Range

$75,804.00 - $81,441.00 Annual Rate

Salary offers are made based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and education as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, and in alignment with salary ranges based on external market data for the job’s level. Internal organization and peer data at Penn are also considered.

"Når du møder dine nye kollegaer i Teknologi og Digitalisering, vil du hurtigt kunne mærke den høje faglighed samt hvordan vi bruger hinanden og giver plads til nye idéer. Hvis du kan lide at stå i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og IT, så tror jeg, du vil trives rigtig godt hos os," siger Henriette Saarup, Leder af Forretningssystemer.


 


Så hvad er det egentlig, du skal?


Som Forretningskonsulent i PFA får du en central rolle i at sikre, at PFA´s kunder og medarbejdere får endnu bedre digitale løsninger. På kort sigt skal du være med til at sikre implementering og ibrugtagning af vores nye enterprise-arkiv baseret på OpenText OTCM (xECM). På længere sigt bliver du central i videreudviklingen af løsningen samt de øvrige applikationer, som teamet har ansvaret for - og de forretningsprocesser, de understøtter. Din opgave er at omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete, digitale løsninger, der både fungerer i hverdagen og forbedrer PFA´s leverancekraft og robusthed


 


Du omsætter behov til værdiskabende digitale løsninger


Som forretningskonsulent bliver du ansvarlig for at:



Identificere og analysere forretningsbehov - særligt i forhold til at gemme, søge og hente digitale dokumenter - og omsætte dem til løsninger, der skaber tydelig værdi for organisationen.


Fungere som bindeled mellem forretningen og udvikling og sikre fælles forståelse af krav, processer og løsninger.


Facilitere workshops, interviews og møder og drive forløb


Udarbejde procesanalyser og kortlægge "as-is" og "to-be"-processer, så vi kan forbedre og effektivisere arbejdsgange.


Bidrage til testarbejdet - fra udarbejdelse af testcases til gennemførsel og opfølgning - så vi sikrer, at løsningerne fungerer i praksis og er klar til implementering.



 


Hvem er du?



Du har erfaring med at befinde dig i krydsfeltet mellem it og forretning, som forretningskonsulent, Business Analyst eller fra en lignende rolle. 


Du har gode analytiske evner og erfaring med behovsafdækning og procesanalyse samt udarbejdelse af kravspecifikationer, user stories og dokumentation


Du har kendskab til agile metoder og gerne erfaring med værktøjer som Azure DevOps eller Jira, og det er en fordel, hvis du også har arbejdet med systemintegration, datamodellering eller IT-arkitektur.


Som person er du imødekommende og samarbejdsorienteret, en stærk kommunikator, der kan gøre komplekse ting enkle, og du arbejder nysgerrigt, struktureret og vedholdende.



 


Din nye afdeling


Du bliver en del af Forretningssystemer, som hører under Teknologi og Digitalisering, og du får 20 gode kollegaer fordelt på to teams. Fokus er at understøtte og udvikle PFA’s kerneforretning og kundeoplevelser. Kulturen er præget af høj faglighed, sparring og en åben, uformel tone, hvor vi deler viden og hjælper hinanden i mål. Du får kolleger, der er optaget af at skabe værdi for vores kunder og forretningen - og som samtidig lægger vægt på et godt socialt miljø i hverdagen.


 


Hvad er det helt særlige, vi kan i PFA?


I PFA er hverdagen noget, vi glæder os til. Vi tror på, at arbejdsglæde og trivsel skaber markante resultater for vores 1,3 mio. kunder og dermed samfundet. Vi gør os umage for at skabe et sted, hvor det både er sjovt og meningsfuldt at gå på arbejde. Her kan du udvikle dig, fagligt og personligt, samtidig med, at du bidrager til noget større.


 


Vi er nemlig omkring 1.400 kolleger, der hver dag arbejder for, at vores kunder kan leve et godt liv, både nu og i fremtiden. Vi hjælper mennesker gennem hele livet, særligt når det handler om vores kunders økonomiske tryghed, deres sundhed og deres seniorliv. Derfor støtter vi selvfølgelig også dig, og vi tilbyder:



Muligheden for at gøre en forskel i Danmarks største pensionsselskab, hvor vi har et højt medarbejderengagement


Et inkluderende fællesskab og medarbejderklubber - fra yoga og løbeklub til fredagscaféer


Fleksible rammer med mulighed for hjemmearbejde og en arbejdsplads, der prioriterer trivsel og arbejdsglæde


Et moderne kontor i hjertet af Nordhavn, tæt på metro, vand og god energi


Attraktiv lønpakke med arbejdsgiverbetalt pension og en god sundhedsforsikring og tandforsikring



 


Kan du se dig selv i en hverdag som PFA’er? Send os bare dit CV!


Du behøver ikke at skrive en lang ansøgning. Vedhæft blot dit CV og tilføj et par linjer i dit resumé om, hvorfor du er interesseret i jobbet inden deadline d. 16. august 2026. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Henriette Saarup, Leder af Forretningssystemer i PFA, på tlf. +45 40 19 70 95 eller via hes@pfa.dk.

title: Director, Campaign Fulfillment & Circulation Operations
description:
About Us
Life Science Connect (LSC) is a community-driven data-enabled media and engagement platform serving professionals across the life sciences industry.

Our digital newsletters, content platforms, and reader data infrastructure exist for one purpose: to inform, connect, and support life science professionals in their work. This engaged, high-quality audience is the foundation of everything we do — and the asset that ultimately enables advertiser partnerships – which fuels our topline growth.

The Role
Life Science Connect (LSC) is seeking a strategic, email marketing operational leader to run the commercial execution engine behind our audience lifecycle. If you’re an expert in email operations, campaign fulfillment, and segmentation—and you love building scalable, disciplined systems—this is the seat where your work directly drives revenue.

Our audience of life science professionals is our core asset. Your job: ensure that every campaign, newsletter, and content promotion reaches the right reader at the right time, with flawless execution and airtight compliance.

What You'll Lead

Campaign & List Operations
  • Own commercial list management and “smart circulations” that auto‑refresh and maintain strict hygiene
  • Execute audience segmentation for advertiser campaigns
  • Manage sponsored sends, co‑reg programs, and all list‑based fulfillment with rigorous QC
Sending Governance & Compliance
  • Define and enforce cross‑portfolio sending rules to prevent fatigue
  • Maintain suppression integrity across all systems with zero tolerance for errors
  • Coordinate a unified sending calendar across brands and teams
Newsletter & Email Operations
  • Oversee templates, deployment, QA, and A/B testing across the newsletter portfolio
  • Implement dynamic content capabilities and mobile‑first rendering standards
  • Build and maintain performance benchmarks and share actionable insights
Deliverability & QA
  • Standardize pre‑send QA: seed tests, rendering checks, spam filtering, link validation
  • Monitor inbox placement, reputation, bounces, and complaints
  • Ensure personalization logic is correct before every send
Campaign Fulfillment & Digital Advertising Ops
  • Run end‑to‑end fulfillment for sponsored newsletters, promotions, and content‑driven campaigns
  • Establish SLAs and repeatable workflows that ensure consistency and high‑quality delivery
  • Oversee and integrate programmatic digital advertising operations
Advertiser Reporting
  • Produce reporting packages that validate delivery, performance, and contracted fulfillment
  • Lead quarterly circulation audits and provide transparent documentation to support renewals
What You Bring
  • 5+ years in email operations, campaign fulfillment, or circulation management
  • Experience in B2B media or publishing strongly preferred
  • Expertise with marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred)
  • Deep knowledge of deliverability, segmentation, and large‑scale newsletter operations
  • Proven ability to build operational processes
  • Proven experience in leading a marketing team
  • Background in life sciences, healthcare, or complex B2B industries is a plus

Why This Role Matters
This isn’t a tactical “email deployer” role.
It’s the operational hub of our commercial model.
You’ll take enriched, segmented B2B audiences—and turn them into revenue through precise, compliant, scalable campaign execution. You’re building the factory that powers advertiser satisfaction, renewal, and growth.

We Invest in YOU
At Life Science Connect, our commitment to empowering innovation and facilitating growth within the life sciences sector extends to our employees. We offer a comprehensive total compensation program designed to support your overall health, financial well-being, and professional development.

In addition to a competitive salary, you'll enjoy:

  • Medical/vision/prescription/dental coverage for you and your family

  • 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability insurance

  • 100% company-paid life insurance

  • 401(k) with dollar-for-dollar company match up to 6%

  • 15 vacation days and 6 personal days on day 1

  • 13 company-paid holidays


We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.
