title: Seasonal Shelter Assistant
description:
Seasonal Shelter Assistant (6 Months)
Compensation: $21.00 per hour
Duration: 4-Month Seasonal Position

About the Organization
A leading nonprofit animal welfare organization dedicated to protecting animals, inspiring compassion, and strengthening the bond between people and pets. Through sheltering, veterinary services, wildlife rehabilitation, and community outreach, the organization provides vital programs that save lives and create a more humane community.

About the Role
We are looking for a compassionate and dedicated Seasonal Shelter Assistant to join our Veterinary Services team. In this role, you will provide medical and humane care to sheltered animals, assist veterinarians with examinations, and support daily shelter operations. This is a hands-on position ideal for someone who is passionate about animal welfare and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Conduct morning and evening rounds to ensure the well-being of all sheltered animals
  • Prepare daily lists of animals requiring veterinary exams
  • Administer daily medical treatments as prescribed by staff veterinarians
  • Perform health checks prior to adoption, including microchip scanning, ID banding, vaccination, deworming, and photographing animals
  • Assist veterinarians with animal examinations
  • Support Lost and Found by providing walkthroughs to clients and maintaining related paperwork
  • Assist in the Spay & Neuter Clinic, including cleaning of the clinic and surgical instruments, and returning post-surgery animals to their kennels
  • Kennel and return animals to the Receiving Department as needed
  • Check and log phone messages for Veterinary Assistants
  • Sort and organize donated items
  • Maintain clean, sanitary, and safe work areas
  • Perform general office duties
  • May supervise volunteers assisting with shelter treatments
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED; or six months to one year of related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Must possess a valid California Driver's License with a clean driving record
  • Must be available to work weekends and holidays as needed
  • Must pass a background check upon hire
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office and data entry; willingness to learn Chameleon database software
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to lift and/or move up to 50–75 pounds
Work Environment
This position involves routine exposure to animals (including aggressive or feral animals), cleaning chemicals, and outdoor weather conditions. The work environment is typically loud. This role has designated start times due to time-sensitive shelter operations.

title: RN Neuro/Ortho 7P FT
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

This position has the authority, responsibility, and shift accountability for the delivery of nursing care through the use of the nursing process. The incumbent accepts accountability, applies competent clinical knowledge skills, and uses independent nursing judgment for care provided by self and by health care providers to whom care is delegated to achieve quality patient care outcomes.

The incumbent must demonstrate the knowledge and skills at the novice level necessary to provide care that is relevant to the patient(s) under their care, as well as apply principles of growth and development over the life span. The incumbent also must possess the ability to assess and interpret patient data needed to identify each patient's requirements relative to his or her age-specific needs. This role provides professional nursing care for patients in an inpatient hospital setting.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Current Registered Nurse license issued by the state in which services will be provided or current multi-state Registered Nurse license through the enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact (eNLC).

2. Obtain certification in Basic Life Support within 30 days of hire date.

EXPERIENCE:

1. Less than 12 months of experience as a registered nurse.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Bachelors of Science in Nursing Degree (BSN).

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Demonstrates safety and continuity of care using methods such as documentation, handoff tools/processes, etc.

2. Demonstrates ability to create plan of care using the nursing process: assessment, diagnoses, intervention, and evaluation of outcomes.

3. Recognizes patient safety concerns through appropriate resources.

4. Provides education based on unique learning needs of patient.

5. Incorporates patient individuality & mutuality data in delivery of care.

6. Performs an adequate patient assessment and documentation.

7. Demonstrates teach-back method to evaluate effectiveness of education.

8. Utilizes Evidence-Based Practice (EBP) in nursing care.

9. Participates in organizational patient-centered care model.

10. Documents problems and issues in the plan of care.

11. Demonstrates growth in ability to care for more complex patients utilizing consultation with experienced colleagues.

12. Demonstrates a commitment to lifelong learning through self-reflection and inquiry for learning and personal growth.

13. Retains accountability for delegated nursing care.

14. Recognizes scope of practice for all interprofessional team members.

15. Participates in holistic, culturally sensitive data collection.

16. Assesses the impact of family dynamics on healthcare consumer health and wellness.

17. Integrates the American Nursing Association (ANA)’s code of ethics to guide nursing practice.

18. Identifies discriminatory health care practices in culturally diverse populations.

19. Individualizes care based on beliefs, barriers, and readiness to learn of patients.

For facilities with specialty accreditation requirements:

1. Completion of annual required education related to specialty accreditation as defined by accreditation standards. Training may be completed through CBLs, trainings, In-services, and competency validation.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. The National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health recommends minimizing the need for employees to manually lift patients, and limit safe patient handling to 35 pounds. All transfers, lifts and re-positioning will be completed utilizing the lift equipment and/or other patient handling aids as indicated by the patient’s profile and appropriate algorithms.

2. Heavy/Hard work: Work requires strength and/or stamina, lifting, moving, stooping, reaching, standing, walking, and carrying of materials and equipment weighing 40+lbs.

3. Visual acuity must be within normal range.

4. Hearing within normal range is required (i.e. to assess breath sounds, bowel sounds, apical pulse, monitors, etc.)

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Working protracted or irregular hours.

2. Working around biohazards.

3. Working around infectious diseases.

4. Working with or near the deceased.

5. Working with hands in water.

6. Working with electrical hazards associated with patient care equipment.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

1. Possesses the interpersonal skills to positively and effectively communicate, negotiate, and resolve conflict.

2. Uses competent clinical practice and critical thinking skills to efficiently deliver patient care with all health care providers while maximizing efficient use of resources.

3. Ability to be flexible in response to changes in work volume, staff and scheduling changes.

4. Ability to work successfully under highly stressful conditions and capable of adapting to varying workloads and work assignments on a constant basis.

The CAPE program is a system-wide clinical advancement program (clinical ladder) to enhance professional development, provide a reward system for quality clinical performance, promote quality nursing, and improve job satisfaction for inpatient direct care nurses.

To apply for the next level, the CAPE nurse must meet the requirements of their current level. They must also meet the required years of nursing experience, degree, and certification to apply for the next level. In addition, nurses who are approved for levels 3, 4, 5, or 6 must complete and submit five competencies on an annual basis to maintain their current level.

Level 1

  • No experience required
  • All graduate nurses with less than 12 months of experience enter at Level one with a diploma, ADN, BSN, or higher

Level 2

  • Meets requirements for previous level
  • One year of experience.

Level 3

  • Meets requirements for previous levels
  • Two years of experience, plus one specialty certification
  • Certification is Preferred but not required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students

Level 4

  • Available to those with a BSN or higher or nurses with ADN/diploma with 5 years of experience
  • one specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and/or shared governance at the unit level

Level 5

  • Available to those with an MSN or higher with 4 years of experience, or nurses with a BSN with 4 years of experience and a health-related Master’s Degree, or nurses with a BSN and 5 years of experience
  • One specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and shared governance at the organization level

Level 6

  • Available to those with an MSN or higher degree with 7 or more years of experience. Consideration is given to other health-related advanced degrees that would assist with direct patient care at the bedside
  • One specialty certification is required
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of regularly being a charge nurse and/or precepting new staff or nursing students
  • Required competencies to include demonstration of participation in QI and shared governance at the system level

title: Field Project Manager – Concrete Forms
description:
UFP Concrete Forming Solutions is the leading supplier of lumber, plywood and value-add, custom formwork solutions to the concrete construction industry.

The Field Project Manager plays a critical role in driving the successful execution of concrete formwork projects—from contract award through final closeout. This position ensures every project meets customer expectations while delivering on operational excellence, financial performance, and schedule commitments. As the central point of communication between customers and internal teams—including Sales, Design/Estimating, and Operations—you will lead the coordination of design, fabrication, delivery, and field support to ensure seamless project success.

Location: Miami

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Manage projects end-to-end, coordinating across Sales, Design, Estimating, Purchasing, Production, Delivery, and Field Support.

  • Develop and manage critical project timelines; obtain customer approval and track progress through completion and customer satisfaction.

  • Lead project kickoff and ongoing communication to confirm scope, dates, constraints, and formwork requirements (rental vs. sale, CNC/custom needs, architectural features, pour breaks, etc.).

  • Review and approve formwork design/detail drawings prior to release; support internal technical reviews and customer approval cycles.

title: Data Analysis Assistant
description:
Company Description

Ubisoft is a global leader in the video game industry, with teams around the world creating original and memorable experiences, from Assassin's Creed and Rainbow Six to Just Dance and much more. We believe that diversity of perspectives enables both players and teams to thrive. If you are passionate about innovation and pushing the boundaries of entertainment, join us and help create the unknown!

Job Description

As a Data Analysis Assistant, you will contribute to the activities of the sales analysis and development team by participating in the collection, analysis, and interpretation of data to answer business questions related to acquisition, retention, monetization, and performance tracking. Under the supervision of more experienced analysts or team leads, you will contribute to the production of reports, dashboards, and simple analyses that enable teams to better understand business trends.

This position is ideal for a curious person who is efficiency-oriented through AI, analytical, collaborative, and eager to develop data analysis skills in a business and video game context. This is a 6-month contract.

What You Will Do

  • Participate in the collection, preparation, and analysis of data related to buyers, subscribers, and players from various sources to support business questions related to acquisition, retention, monetization, and performance tracking.
  • Support multidisciplinary teams in analyzing key business trends and evaluating sales and marketing performance, contributing to the identification of data-driven opportunities and insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of SQL queries, processes, methodologies, and conclusions to support knowledge sharing and data integrity.
  • Participate in data management activities to maintain sound data governance and report accuracy, and take part in identifying and resolving data issues alongside senior analysts and other data teams.
  • Use, when relevant and in accordance with company guidelines, AI-assisted tools to support various data analytics tasks, such as query writing, data exploration, documentation, information synthesis, and process efficiency improvement.
  • Create dashboards, reports, and presentations to communicate results to stakeholders and contribute to data valorization through data storytelling.
  • Participate in team initiatives, including supporting the migration to Databricks by executing assigned tasks such as testing, documentation, validation, or updating dashboards and queries.

Qualifications

What You Will Bring

  • Currently studying or recently graduated with a degree in a technical or quantitative discipline (data science, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or related field).
  • Knowledge of SQL query concepts and data mining.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (including pivot tables).
  • Technical comfort, quick learning ability, and curiosity.
  • Collaborative spirit and strong communication skills.
  • Organizational sense and comfort with technical documentation writing.
  • Interest in or experience with AI tools or AI-assisted workflows for tasks such as SQL query writing, dataset analysis, process documentation, or results synthesis.

Assets

  • Experience with tools such as Databricks, Snowflake, Teradata, or Hive
  • Knowledge of Python and/or R
  • Knowledge of VBA or automated data connections
  • Experience with business intelligence visualization tools, including Power BI (primarily), Tableau, Looker, or others
  • Passion for the video game industry

title: Community Engagement Liaison
description:
Build relationships that produce meaningful results for children and families. As CK Family Services’ Community Engagement Liaison, you will spend much of your time in the community—initiating conversations, meeting new people, representing our mission, opening doors, and moving promising relationships toward referrals, foster parent inquiries, donations, resources, partnerships, and other measurable outcomes. This is a visible, fast-moving role for someone who enjoys influencing action, maintaining momentum, and confidently following up even when the first response is “not now."

Job Summary

The Community Engagement Liaison is a relationship-centered, externally focused member of the Marketing and Communications (MarComm) team and is supervised by the Chief Business Development Officer. The position builds trusted community relationships, creates access to new audiences and partners, and converts engagement opportunities into measurable value for CK Family Services.

The Community Engagement Liaison represents CK Family Services in the community, conducts purposeful outreach, develops and maintains stakeholder relationships, and moves promising conversations toward clear next steps. Depending on assignment, the position may generate referrals for children’s mental and behavioral health services, foster parent inquiries, donations, resources, partnerships, access opportunities, or other defined value.

Key Outputs

  1. Achievement of established minimum production targets for documented referrals, foster parent inquiries, donations, resources, access opportunities, collaborations, community intelligence, or other defined value associated with assigned programs, initiatives, and strategic priorities.
  2. Purposeful execution and follow-through on approved engagement strategies that produce assigned outcomes, supported by established goals, performance information, coaching, and internal resources.
  3. Timely documentation and communication of useful stakeholder feedback, recurring community themes, barriers, opportunities, concerns, and other observations that may inform leadership decisions or adjustments.

Primary Outcome

CK Family Services consistently acquires the referrals, foster parent inquiries, donations, resources, access, collaborations, and community intelligence needed to advance assigned programs, initiatives, and strategic priorities.

Success Factors

Success in this position requires strong relationship-building skills, credibility, curiosity, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through. The Community Engagement Liaison must be able to understand stakeholder interests, identify shared value, and move conversations toward clear next steps and measurable results.

The employee must learn assigned CK Family Services programs and priorities well enough to represent them accurately, recognize useful opportunities, and remain within established authority. The position also requires comfort with clear production goals and a willingness to use provided tools, reports, coaching, and support to improve outreach and follow-up.

The Community Engagement Liaison must communicate useful community feedback, barriers, concerns, and opportunities to internal leaders and work effectively within a structure in which the Chief Business Development Officer provides direct management and the Director of Community Engagement provides functional leadership and guidance.

Support Provided

The Community Engagement Liaison is supported through established goals, approved engagement strategies, messaging, CRM workflows, reporting templates, performance dashboards, training, administrative processes, and access to internal subject-matter experts.

The Chief Business Development Officer provides direct management, priorities, performance expectations, accountability, and final direction. The Director of Community Engagement provides functional leadership, coaching, relationship-development guidance, and support for community-engagement activity.

The Community Engagement Liaison is expected to use these resources to remain organized, document important activity, maintain purposeful follow-up, review provided performance information, and improve results over time. Broader analysis, strategic prioritization, and organizational decision-making remain the responsibility of leadership.

Work Location and Environment

This position is based in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. The Community Engagement Liaison works primarily from home and/or from the employee’s location within the DFW metroplex while carrying out position responsibilities. CK Family Services provides access to shared workspace at its three DFW metroplex locations for optional use and occasional business needs. This position is not assigned to a dedicated office or permanent workstation. In-person attendance at a CK Family Services office is required only as needed for meetings, training, or other business purposes.

Position Schedule and Availability

This is a salaried position funded with the expectation of a full-time, 40-hour work week. The position generally operates with primary availability during traditional business hours; however, the nature of the work requires flexibility to perform work activities at times that support goal attainment and mission progression. Evening and other nontraditional work hours may be necessary based on candidate availability, meetings, events, and position demands. Performance in this role is measured primarily by achievement of assigned outputs and contribution to the position’s primary outcome.

General Responsibilities

  1. Develop, maintain, and appropriately leverage professional relationships with customers, clients, referral sources, service providers, community organizations, faith communities, schools, businesses, public agencies, advocacy groups, donors, volunteers, and other relevant stakeholders.
  2. Conduct purposeful outreach intended to generate assigned referrals, foster parent inquiries, donations, resources, access opportunities, collaborations, community intelligence, or other defined value.
  3. Represent CK Family Services professionally at meetings, presentations, outreach activities, community events, partnership activities, fundraising activities, and other external opportunities.
  4. Move promising stakeholder conversations toward clear next steps through timely follow-up, relationship development, information sharing, introductions, meetings, referrals, requests, or other approved actions.
  5. Develop and maintain a working understanding of the services, eligibility requirements, service areas, capacity, priorities, production needs, and engagement opportunities associated with assigned CK Family Services programs, initiatives, and strategic priorities.
  6. Engage regularly with designated internal leaders and staff to understand current referral, inquiry, fundraising, resource, access, partnership, and community-information needs.
  7. Work from approved engagement strategies, goals, priorities, messaging, and production targets established by the Chief Business Development Officer and supported by the Director of Community Engagement.
  8. Identify and connect external stakeholder needs, resources, and opportunities with relevant CK Family Services programs, initiatives, and priorities while seeking guidance before making commitments outside established authority.
  9. Listen carefully for useful community feedback, recurring concerns, misconceptions, referral barriers, access challenges, stakeholder reactions, emerging opportunities, and other relevant observations.
  10. Communicate important stakeholder and community observations to the Chief Business Development Officer, Director of Community Engagement, and other appropriate internal leaders in a timely and clear manner.
  11. Use CK Family Services-provided systems and templates to maintain timely records of key stakeholder relationships, opportunities, commitments, follow-up actions, referrals, inquiries, donations, resources, collaborations, and outcomes.
  12. Participate in routine performance-review and reporting processes by providing accurate activity and outcome information, reviewing provided reports or dashboards, and using coaching to strengthen outreach and follow-up.
  13. Implement approved adjustments to engagement activity, messaging, targeting, follow-up, or relationship-development approaches based on leadership direction, coaching, and performance information.
  14. Prepare and deliver clear presentations, meeting summaries, stakeholder updates, and other communication materials using approved tools, templates, messaging, and support.
  15. Participate in CK Family Services meetings, training, planning sessions, coaching, and other internal activities necessary to maintain knowledge, alignment, and effectiveness.
  16. Protect confidential and sensitive organizational, stakeholder, client, and consumer information and follow CK Family Services procedures relevant to community engagement.
  17. Travel locally as needed to support meetings, outreach, events, presentations, partnership activity, and other position-related responsibilities.
  18. Perform other duties as assigned in support of the purpose, outputs, and outcome of the position.

Note: Items 1 through 17 are essential tasks of this job.

    Help us build the contract performance platform of tomorrow. 
 We are building an AI-native Contract Performance Management platform aiming to become the European leader. 

 Every business runs on contracts. Millions move every day based on agreed terms. But most companies can't tell you what their contracts are actually worth. The truth only surfaces in costly and time consuming audits. 

 Contracts have become the 'financial infrastructure of the business' but no software caught up. We're building the layer that do catch up, for the European mid-market, with AI doing the heavy lifting from day one. 

 Come help us solve a real pain in a huge market working with an experienced team and a modern tech stack where we ship multiple times a day.  

 
  
 About us  
 
 Founded in 2023 
 

 
 Five co-founders with six prior exits 
 

 
 Headquartered in Aarhus 
 

 
 Flat org with no layers between you and the founders 
 

 
 All smiles and happy faces 

 
  
 
  What you'll build  
 
 AI-native from the core. LLMs, agents, retrieval - not a side feature. The heart of how contracts become structured financial truth. 
 

 
 Real-time financial intelligence. Earned, projected, missed and actual value across thousands of contracts and millions of transactions, continuously computed. 
 

 
 ERP integrations done right. Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, e-conomic. Robust, idempotent, observable. 
 

 
 Live, reactive UI. Dashboards and projections that update in real time. WebSockets, not refresh buttons. 
 

 
 Foundational architecture. The calls you make today shape the platform for years. The CTO backs your judgement. 
 
 
 This isn't a backlog-ticket role. You'll own surfaces end-to-end, design, ship, monitor, talk to the customer, watch the impact land.

VMware / Virtual Infrastructure Administration:

- Manage and maintain VMware vSphere environment, including ESXi hosts and vCenter Server Appliance (VCSA)

- Monitor system performance, resource utilization (CPU, RAM, GPU), and storage

- Perform VM lifecycle management (deployment, snapshots, backups, cloning)

- Ensure high availability and system resiliency within an offline environment

- Perform upgrades, patches, and backups

- Support ArcGIS Pro users and licensing

Database & Data Management:

- Configure IIS, DNS, and internal networking

- Implement security policies in an air-gapped environment

- Perform system patching and updates (offline)

- Manage user accounts and access controls

- Maintain system documentation

Hardware & GPU Resource Management:

- Support NVIDIA L40 GPU environments

- Allocate GPU resources for ArcGIS Pro VMs

- Monitor GIS workload performance

- Scripting (PowerShell, Python)

Key Skills:

- Problem-solving and analytical thinking

- Strong communication and documentation

- Ability to work independently

- Attention to detail

Work Environment:

- Able to work in a secure space

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, and a list of applications that are not AI-native to organise their lives. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

Create beautiful, fast, and intuitive interfaces for A1.

You'll focus on the visual design of our products, ensuring every screen is clear, polished, and easy to use. Working alongside Product Designers and engineers, you'll bring the user experience to life through exceptional interface design.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design high-quality user interfaces

  • Build and maintain UI components and design systems.

  • Refine layouts, typography, spacing, and visual consistency.

  • Work closely with product and engineering to deliver pixel-perfect experiences.

  • Continuously improve the quality of the product interface.

What You Will Need

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating UI design work.

  • Excellent visual design, typography, and layout skills.

  • Experience building and maintaining design systems.

  • Proficiency with Figma.

  • Strong attention to detail and craftsmanship.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Our goal is to build products that are genuinely useful to billions of people globally.

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design challenge.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
About The Role: Innovative Defense Technologies (IDT), a leading defense technology company, is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to be part of our Warfare Systems team and based out of our Arlington, VA or Mount Laurel, NJ location. The Senior Systems Engineer will work as a critical part of a multi-discipline team focused on the DOD's initiatives in support of tactical capability development for Navy surface and unmanned (UxVs) platforms. The Warfare Systems project domains include real-time automated test and analysis, virtual computing environments, Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Machine Learning (ML) based data analytics, cybersecurity, as well as backfit and forward-fit tactical solutions. The successful candidate will be fiercely accountable for the delivery of uncompromisingly punctual and fiscally disciplined solutions that not only meet but go above and beyond the expectations of every customer. Clearance & Location Requirements:
  • All applicants must be able to obtain/maintain an active Secret U.S. Security Clearance.
  • This is an on-site position. Requiring at least 3 days in office, based out of our Arlington, VA and Mount Laurel, NJ locations.
Department Engineering Employment Type Full Time Location Mount Laurel, NJ Address 8000 Midlantic Drive, Suite 500 N, Mount Laurel, New Jersey, 08054 Open in Google Maps Workplace type Hybrid Compensation $114,000 - $273,000 / year
Key Responsibilities
What You Will Do:
  • Design, implement, and test complex software in C, C++, Python, JavaScript, and Java within various development environments.
  • Analyze legacy monolithic software programs, recompiling them, and incrementally apply refactoring to modernize the software using the "brownfield" and "greenfield" methodologies.
  • Technical assessment and deconstruction of Navy tactical system code for Surface Navy Combat systems.
  • Explore and prototype next-generation solutions using artificial intelligence/machine learning, distributed processing, and modeling.
  • Interact with customers to elicit requirements and document agreements.
  • Present to organization leadership on project cost, schedule, and technical progress.
  • Software architecture development including hardware and software interfaces between software components.
  • Assist in developing user, functional, and technical requirements for tactical systems.
  • Participate and provide feedback for design & code/peer reviews.
  • Integrate individual software components into complex software environments.
  • Support test and integration activities at IDT labs and government Land Based Test Sites (LBTS).
Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
Who You Are (Required):
  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering or a related field, or equivalent full-time professional experience.
  • 5-10+ years of full-time professional experience.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, as needed.
  • Familiarity with combat system design and software.
  • Familiarity and experience with developing tactical systems software on DOD programs.
  • Experience with C, C++, Python, and/or Java programming languages.
  • Adept with developing in Linux OS environments, including shell scripting.
  • Ability to decompose and document requirements and specifications.
  • Understanding of distributed systems, algorithms, data structures and software design patterns, especially the Strangler Pattern.
  • Experience with Agile software development processes.
  • Proficiency working within a Git CM environment.
  • Comfortable with DevSecOps best practices.
  • Ability to convert vague customer requirements into a refined vision.

   Salgsassistentelev til serviceenheden - Varde 
  Salgsassistentelev til kundeservice og bagerudsalg 
 Uddannelsen som salgsassistentelev er i sig selv spændende, men hos føtex tager du ikke bare en uddannelse, du bliver en del af noget større. føtex er en af Danmarks største detailkæder og hos os står mulighederne i kø - karriere, kompetencer og kammerater er bare nogle af de mange muligheder man kan få når man trækker i den blå uniform. 

 Som medarbejder hos føtex bliver din rygsæk fyldt med erfaringer - dem kan du bruge nu, sammen med os, men også senere hen i din karriere.  Vi har et rigtig godt sammenhold, hvor vi bakker hinanden op og løfter i flok. Vi sørger naturligvis for den helt rette træning, så du kan føle dig tryg og kompetent i jobbet. 

 I Salling Group tror vi på dig og din succes og det er alene dig som sætter begrænsningen for din udvikling - her er der højt til loftet og mange muligheder. Uddannelsen inviterer til målrettet arbejde med din personlige såvel som faglige udvikling. 

 Nogle af de mange gode fordele ved at tage uddannelsen i føtex: 
 
 fleksibilitet og indflydelse på din arbejdsplan og i jobbet som helhed 

 en app hvor du kan se din arbejdsplan og hvor du modtager relevant information 

 en arbejdsplads med stærkt fællesskab hvor der er plads til alle og til at være præcis den du er. Du vil med andre ord også kunne skabe dig et godt socialt netværk og møde nye venner. 

 et hav af medarbejdergoder, bl.a.: personalerabatter, koncerter og festlige events. 

 efter endt uddannelse har du fremragende muligheder for at fortsætte din karriere indenfor Salling Group 
 
 Om kundeservice, kasselinje og bagerudsalg
  Som medarbejder ved kassen og i kundeservice er du helt i front hos kunderne. I kasselinjen sørger du for, at varerne registreres korrekt, betaling gennemføres og at vores kunder er opmærksom på vores kampagner - det kunne blandt andet være guldmærker eller samlekort. 
  
  Du har den fornemme opgave at sørge for, at kundens afsluttende oplevelse ved indkøbsturen i varehuset, bliver så god som muligt. I kundeservice er det vores fornemmeste opgave at sørge for, at kunden hurtigst muligt for løst deres problem og kommer godt videre.Kundeservice er et knudepunkt for kunder såvel som medarbejdere idet meget information og håndtering går denne vej igennem - det kræver et stærkt overblik og gode kommunikative evner. 
  
  I bageriudsalget har vi varehusets bedste duft. Bagerudsalget er sprængfyldt med lækker bagværk og flotte kager. Bagerudsalgets medarbejdere sørger for en flot og indbydende opsætning i disken så kunderne inspireres. Derudover holder man god rengøring og orden så det er et indbydende sted at handle. Sidst, men ikke mindst, sørger man for, en fremragende kundeoplevelse med god vejledning og service.
   

 Følg med her, hvor Milan fortæller om jobbet og uddannelsen i føtex! 
 
     
 

 Hvordan bliver du salgsassistentelev? 

 Du har færdiggjort én af følgende eksaminer: 
 
 EUD/EUX Business-eksamen 

 HHX-eksamen 

 Studentereksamen, HF-eksamen eller HTX-eksamen, kombineret med 5-ugers EUD/HGS 
 
 Du har interesse for detailhandlen og tror på egne evner og forstår vigtigheden i at samarbejde og kommunikere. Du udvikler dig fagligt, tager ansvar, leverer resultater, stræber efter forbedringer og er en holdspiller. 

 Du har viljen og engagementet, blandt andet til at yde Danmarks bedste kundeservice og dermed bringe føtex i front som kundernes foretrukne detailvarehus. 

 Du har en god energi og personlighed som sætter et positivt præg på arbejdet og dine kollegaer. 

 Er du klar til at sende din ansøgning afsted?
  Hvis du stadig er nysgerrig på de mange muligheder føtex kan tilbyde, og er klar til at give den fuld gas i føtex’ blå uniform, så klik på linket nedenfor og lad os høre mere om, hvem du er. Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig :) 

 Har du spørgsmål?
  Du kan læse mere om salgsassistentelevuddannelsen  her . 

 Salling Group er en mangfoldig arbejdsplads med 60.000 medarbejdere i Danmark, Tyskland og Polen. 

 Vi driver butikker, varehuse, cafeer, spisesteder og webshops med vægt på kvalitet, service og omtanke for de samfund og den klode, vi er en del af. 

 Vi brænder for at gøre hverdagen bedre for vores kunder

title: Sustainability Principles - Thi Thao Copenhagen
description:
Sustainability Principles - Thi Thao Copenhagen

		
	
	
	

	
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		






















































































	
	
			
			
			
			
			















		Gå til indholdet



			
			

		

		

						

				

											


																								

										

			





		

									

												

					

								

			

	
 


		

		

									


						

	

				

						

			





		

					

			

		
			

		

		

	


		
					
				

	
				
				Principper for bæredygtighed			 
		



	
	
Vi ønsker at Thi Thao Copenhagen skal være en bæredygtig virksomhed. Vores tankegang er præciseret som 5 principper for bæredygtighed. 

Der er sagt og skrevet meget, om hvordan modebranchen står for en betydelig del af verdens CO2 udledning. Geneva Environment Network opsummerer det ganske godt: https://www.genevaenvironmentnetwork.org/resources/updates/sustainable-fashion/

Vi har målrettet opbygget Thi Thao Copenhagen som en virksomhed, hvor vi stræber efter miljømæssig harmoni baseret på vores bæredygtighedsprincipper.

Vi påstår ikke, at vi er CO2 fri - vi har for mange forskellige leverandører til med rette at kunne gøre det, men vi styrer vores produktion efter 4 principper for bæredygtighed, der hjælper os med at minimere vores miljømæssige aftryk, og 1 princip der sikrer fair arbejdsbetingelser, til de der producerer vores tøj.


1. princip for bæredygtighed: Vi overproducerer ikke



Vi overproducerer ikke


10-40% af det tøj, der produceres i verden, er overproduktion, der ender som affald uden at gavne nogen forbrugere.



Vi har beregnet at en overproduktion på 10 % svarer til 223,5 millioner tons unødvendig CO2-udledning årligt. Det er mere end den samlede CO2-udledning fra alle nordiske lande.



Dertil kan man lægge al den CO2 fra transport af overskydende produktion, som ofte skal cirkuleres mellem forskellige salgssteder - fordi det er overskydende produktion.



Vores måde at reducere overproduktion på er kun at lave få prøver, som vores kunder kan prøve/købe. Det meste af det tøj, vi sælger, er lavet til at passe den enkelte kunde.



For forbrugeren giver dette et stort antal tilpasningsmuligheder. 80% af vores kunder bruger deres tilpasningsmuligheder til at vælge deres egne farver og påvirke de tekstiler, vi fremstiller deres tøj i.






Vi minimerer transport


CO2-udledning fra transport er fortsat en stor miljømæssig udfordring. Afhængigt af den globale vilje til at ændre status quo, mener vi, at dette har potentiale til at omforme værdikæder.



Transport af tekstiler og andre materialer til vores produktionsfaciliteter er uundgåelig. Vi har tillid til, at transportsektoren arbejder hårdt på at reducere deres påvirkning. Det, vi kan gøre i denne henseende, er begrænset til at reducere vores transportbehov.



Vi producerer derfor bevidst vores tøj så tæt på slutbrugeren som muligt. Hvis du besøger vores flagskibsbutik i København, vil du bemærke, at vores produktion er placeret direkte under vores butik.



Vores korte forsyningslinjer gavner forbrugerne med hurtig levering på trods af de betydelige tilpasningsmuligheder, vi tilbyder.




2. princip for bæredygtighed: Vi minimerer transport



3. princip for bæredygtighed: Vi prioriterer bæredygtige materialer



Vi prioriterer bæredygtige materialer


For at forstå hvor giftig tekstilproduktion KAN være, kan du nemt finde billeder online af de skader, som bomuldsmarksarbejderne har lidt. Den grundlæggende kendsgerning er, at kemikalier, der bruges i tekstilproduktionen, forbliver i stoffet, når du køber tøjet.



At undgå giftige stoffer handler både om at passe på dig som kunde og vores egne medarbejdere, der laver tøjet. Vores hud er trods alt vores største organ, og for os er det sund fornuft at begrænse de giftstoffer, vi som mennesker udsætter os selv for.



Det promoverer og støtter også de virksomheder, der gør en indsats for at minimere både de kemiske effekter på vores planet, og dem, der arbejder på at skabe bæredygtige alternativer.



Vi prioriterer bæredygtige materialer i alle tilfælde, hvor det er muligt. Vores betingelse for at vælge bæredygtige alternativer er, at de ikke er af ringere kvalitet end de ikke-bæredygtige alternativer.



Dette er et område, der nyder stor opmærksomhed, og vi er klar til helhjertet at omfavne det gode, der kommer fra det innovative arbejde, som verdens stofproducenter udfører. Vi er glade for at bidrage til den øgede brug af bæredygtige stoffer i modeproduktion.



For os er kvalitet og funktionalitet nøgleord, og de kan ikke let erstattes med billigere alternativer. Omkring 95% af de tøjfibre, vi bruger, er naturlige fibre såsom uld eller silke. Hvis vi har brug for at bruge bomuld, vil vi forsøge at finde en bæredygtig, økologisk bomuld.



Al forskning, vi kan finde, viser, at naturlige fibre er svære at overgå. Tøj af silke- og uld forbliver i forbrugernes garderober længe og bruges betydeligt oftere end beklædningsgenstande lavet af syntetiske fibre. Mange varer bruges stadig 10 år efter de er købt. Se f.eks. Woolmark + Nielsen data; 2018 meta-analysis)



For de resterende 5% af fibrene i vores produktion prioriterer vi også bæredygtige alternativer, hvis det kan lade sig gøre. Det kunne være stof af regererede stoffibre, overproduktion fra andre modehuse eller certificeret bæredygtigt stof.



Hvis du har lyst, kan du se nogle af vores produkter i vores webshop.




Vi minimerer spild


Tekstilproduktion, tøjproduktion og bortskaffelse af brugt tøj bidrager alle med tonsvis af affald. En rapport fra Boston Consulting Group (BCG) fra 2025 antyder, at det globale tekstilaffald nåede op på   120 millioner tons i 2024 . BCG-publikationen.



At reducere overproduktion reducerer i sig selv spild, men vi går længere end det.



Vi køber stoffer i små mængder og bestiller specialfarvede metervarer, når kunderne bestiller disse. Dette begrænser stofproduktionen til de farver, der rent faktisk sælges.



Vi placerer altid mønstre omhyggeligt for at minimere spild. Dette maksimerer udnyttelsen af   hvert eneste stof, vi bruger. 



Afskårne stofrester indsamles og gives til skoler og flygtningeinstitutioner, hvor de hjælper børn med at udvikle deres kreative færdigheder. Skoler og institutioner kan klikke HER for at kontakte os omkring at modtage afklip.



Da mange af vores stoffer først bestilles, når de er skal bruges til specifikke kunder, er det muligt for os at købe tekstiler af høj kvalitet på trods af deres normalt højere pris pr. meter. Kvalitet og pris hænger sammen - dette gælder også for tekstiler - og  materialer af høj kvalitet gør det muligt for os at producere tøj, der ofte har længere levetid end tøj af billigere materialer.



Din forbruger-fordel ved vores politik for minimering af spild er de udvidede tilpasningsmuligheder det giver dig, i stedet for blot at vælge mellem få færdige designs i få foruddefinerede farver.



Ulykker sker, og mennesker forandrer sig. Vores after sales service hjælper vores kunder med at forlænge levetiden på deres tøj. Vores skrædderi hjælper med reparation af Thi Thao-tøj, hvis det skulle gå i stykker, og under Vintage section, you can sell Thi Thao clothes you know that you will no longer need.




Thi Thao Copenhagens bæredygtighedsprincip 4: Vi minimerer spild



Thi Thao Copenhagens bæredygtighedsprincip 5: Vi sikrer retfærdige arbejdsforhold



Vi sikrer fair arbejdsforhold


Tekstilindustrien har en lang historie med at jagte lave enhedsomkostninger. I mange tilfælde resulterer dette i dårlige arbejdsforhold, lave lønninger og udnyttelse af arbejdsstyrken. Her er en troværdig kilde til at læse mere: Walk Free / Global Slavery Index — “Stitched with slavery in the seams"



Vi ejer vores produktion. Dette sikrer retfærdige arbejdsforhold, i hvert fald for dem, der producerer vores tøj. Vores nordiske arv gør det naturligt for os at behandle vores medarbejdere som ligeværdige.



Det starter den dag, vi interviewer en potentiel medarbejder. Vi ansætter baseret på færdigheder, personlighed og team fit. Uanset hvilket CV du medbringer, baserer vi vores ansættelsesproces på en praktisk test, der er designet til at vise færdigheder, mangler og potentiale til at passe til den rolle, vi interviewer til.



Vores lønninger er på branche niveau. Vi sigter ikke efter at tiltrække medarbejdere udelukkende gennem lønninger. Vi bestræber os på at tilbyde job, der gør det til en glædelig oplevelse at gå på arbejde. Nogle gange betyder det at justere arbejdstider eller feriernes længde. Vi er fleksible - og til gengæld er vores medarbejdere fleksible, når vores kunder har brug for det.



Vi ansætter ofte på baggrund af potentiale - f.eks. når vi ser tilstrækkeligt øje for detaljer og kvalitet, men manglende hastighed på grund af manglende erfaring eller sprogbarrierer. I disse tilfælde kan vi skræddersy en individuel onboardingplan, der balancerer vores behov som virksomhed og den enkeltes behov for at træne bestemte færdigheder. Målet med en sådan plan er altid at være til gensidig fordel for medarbejderen og os som virksomhed.



Vi har leverandører af maskiner og råmaterialer. Hvis vi har en fornemmelse af, at en leverandør ikke tilbyder rimelige arbejdsforhold for sine medarbejdere, vil vi erstatte den pågældende leverandør.

  • The workflows are calibrated to the design complexity, safety stakes, and production scale of Fortune 500 and large industrial manufacturers.

  • Contributors design enterprise mechanical engineering scenarios, draft reference outputs, and write rubrics that capture how senior F500 engineering leaders think.

Key Responsibilities

  • Construct enterprise mechanical engineering scenarios spanning complex product design cycles, multi-stakeholder design reviews, and manufacturing or regulatory certification processes at F500 accounts.

  • Build tasks across F500 product design and CAD modeling, thermal/fluid systems analysis, structural and stress analysis, manufacturing process engineering, and reliability/failure analysis.

  • Develop engineering scenarios involving tools such as SolidWorks, ANSYS, CATIA, MATLAB/Simulink, and enterprise PLM systems (Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill) in F500 stacks.

  • Apply enterprise mechanical engineering methodologies (FEA/CFD simulation, DFM/DFA principles, Six Sigma/DFSS, GD&T standards) and produce reference design specifications, engineering analyses, and executive-level technical narratives.

  • Author rubrics that distinguish authentic enterprise mechanical engineering judgment from generic textbook or coursework-level recall.

Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years working as a mechanical engineer or engineering lead at a Fortune 500 industrial, automotive, aerospace, or manufacturing company (GE, Boeing, Caterpillar, Ford, Honeywell).

  • Direct ownership of F500-scale product designs, manufacturing processes, or engineering certification programs.

  • Fluency in enterprise mechanical engineering tooling and methodologies, plus understanding of how F500 safety standards, regulatory certification (ISO, FAA, FDA), and cross-functional design governance actually work.

  • Prior rubric, engineering-training curriculum, or design documentation authorship is a plus.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request.

Contract and Payment Terms

 Senior AI & Data Solutions Architect  

 Location - Ballerup 

   

 Your new role  

   

 The Senior AI & Data Architect is responsible for designing scalable, secure, compliant, and value-driven AI and data solution architectures that enable successful execution of strategic AI initiatives.  

   

 This role partners closely with AI Product Owners, Enterprise Architects, Platform teams and delivery leads (Data Scientists, Data & AI Engineers) to translate business needs into robust technical solution designs. The Senior AI & Data Architect ensures that AI and advanced analytics initiatives are technically feasible, strategically aligned, reusable, governed, and ready for enterprise-scale deployment. 
 
  

 Your key responsibilities include:  

   

  AI & Data solution architecture  
 
 Lead the architecture design for complex AI, advanced analytics, and data product initiatives across Commercial functions.   
  
 Translate business requirements and success criteria into scalable technical solution concepts, data flows, architecture designs, and implementation roadmaps.   
  
 Partner with AI Product Owners to pressure-test use cases for technical feasibility, architectural complexity, data readiness, scalability, and delivery risks.   
  
 Define solution architecture across data ingestion, data engineering, feature engineering, model development, model deployment, integration, monitoring, and user consumption layers.   
  
 Ensure solutions are designed for scalability, maintainability, performance, security, and long-term operational ownership.   
  
 Provide architectural guidance from ideation through deployment and value realization.  
 
   

 2. Technical leadership across AI delivery lifecycle  
 
 Lead technical design discussions across Data Science, AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform, Architecture, Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and business teams.   
  
 Influence technology choices, architecture decisions, solution patterns, and delivery roadmaps for AI and data initiatives.  
  
 Guide end-to-end technical delivery for strategic AI and data projects, ensuring alignment between business objectives, technical implementation, and enterprise standards.   
  
 Identify technical dependencies, constraints, risks, and mitigation plans early in the use case lifecycle.   
  
 Ensure technical designs are pragmatic, reusable, and aligned with delivery timelines and business priorities.  
 
   

 3. Data Architecture & Data Strategy  
 
 Define data architecture for AI and analytics solutions, including data sourcing, integration, transformation, storage, quality, lineage, and access patterns.   
  
 Assess data availability, quality, usability, ownership, and governance requirements for AI use cases.   
  
 Collaborate with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Data Engineers, and business teams to ensure AI solutions are based on trusted and governed data.   
  
 Recommend data product designs and reusable data assets that support multiple AI and analytics use cases.   
  
 Promote standardization of data models, semantic layers, metadata, and data governance practices.   
 
   

 4. AI Architecture, MLOps & GenAI Enablement  
 
 Define architecture patterns for Machine Learning, Generative AI, Natural Language Processing, predictive analytics, optimization, and decision-support solutions.  
  
 Guide model development and deployment approaches, including experimentation environments, model lifecycle management, monitoring, retraining, and performance tracking.  
  
 Ensure implementation of MLOps and LLMOps practices for production-grade AI solutions.  
  
 Define architectural guardrails for prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, model selection, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.  
  
 Support teams in selecting appropriate AI models, platforms, frameworks, APIs, and integration approaches.  
 
   

 5. Enterprise Architecture, Governance & Compliance  
 
 Ensure all AI and data solution designs align with enterprise architecture principles, technology standards, security patterns, compliance requirements, and governance frameworks.   
  
 Recommend standards, best practices, and governance mechanisms for AI solution development and deployment.   
  
 Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Responsible AI teams to ensure solutions meet internal and external requirements.   
  
 Document architecture decisions, solution designs, design trade-offs, risks, and governance approvals.   
  
 Support architecture review boards and technical governance forums.   
  
 Promote consistent use of approved platforms, reusable components, integration standards, and deployment patterns.  
 
   

 6. Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration  
 
 Communicate complex technical concepts in clear business language to senior stakeholders.   
  
 Facilitate technical workshops for solution design, data discovery, architecture alignment, integration planning, and acceptance criteria definition.   
  
 Prepare architecture recommendations, solution options, risk assessments, and technical decision papers for leadership discussions.   
 
   

 7. Reusable Frameworks, Standards & Capability Building  
 
 Develop and maintain reference architectures, reusable design patterns, architecture playbooks, and technical guardrails for AI and data solutions.   
  
 Identify opportunities to standardize and industrialize repeated AI delivery patterns.   
  
 Mentor Data Scientists, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Solution Architects, and technical leads on architecture best practices.   
  
 Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, advancements in AI, data technologies, cloud platforms, and architecture practices.  
 
   

 Your new department:  

   

 This role partners closely with AI Product Owners, Enterprise Architects, Platform teams and delivery leads (Data Scientists, Data & AI Engineers) to translate business needs into robust technical solution designs. The Senior AI & Data Architect ensures that AI and advanced analytics initiatives are technically feasible, strategically aligned, reusable, governed, and ready for enterprise-scale deployment.  

   

 The role is critical in de-risking AI delivery by guiding technology choices, architecture decisions, data strategy, integration patterns, platform usage, Responsible AI controls, and solution scalability across the AI use case portfolio. This directly complements the AI Product Owners role, which focuses on business problem framing, prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and value realization.

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.  
  
 Master’s degree in data science, AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or equivalent experience preferred.   
  
 Architecture, cloud, data, AI, or security certifications are an advantage.  
  
 10+ years of experience in AI/data solution architecture, enterprise architecture, data engineering, analytics, or digital solution delivery.   
  
 5+ years of experience designing and delivering data, analytics, AI, Machine Learning, or cloud-based solutions.   
  
 Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale data and AI solutions in complex, matrixed organizations.   
  
 Experience working with senior business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into scalable technical designs.   
  
 Experience with data platforms, cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, data governance, security, privacy, and production-grade AI deployment.   
  
 Experience guiding cross-functional teams across Data Science, Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Platform, Security, Architecture, and business functions.

title: PRINCIPAL PRODUCT DESIGNER
description:
Principal / Lead Product Designer

💡Location: Toronto, Canada

💡Duration: 6 to 12 months contract, with potential for extension

💡Experience Level: 10–15 years


Who we are:
Foolproof is a product and service design company. We bring together insight, creativity and technology to design, engineer and market experiences. With studios in the UK, North America, India and South Africa, we operate globally.
To deliver creative and technological change we partner with our parent company Zensar, a leading digital and technology solutions provider, and Indigo Slate, our sister Studio, who specialize in marketing and consultancy. Together, we bring digital transformation programs to life for major brands.

Role Description:
We are seeking an experienced Principal Product Designer to lead strategic product initiatives in the sustainability and environmental impact space. This role will shape and deliver innovative products and services that help organizations achieve their ESG, net-zero, and sustainable growth objectives.
You will work across cross-functional teams and client stakeholders to define the product vision, roadmap, and delivery plans that embed sustainability at the core of strategy and execution.

What you will be doing:

  • Define and drive product and experience strategy across large, ambiguous problem spaces, with a strong focus on transforming complex, data-rich ecosystems into simple, scalable, and user-friendly experiences.
  • Strategic Leadership: Define and drive product strategy that aligns with sustainability goals and measurable impact outcomes.
  • Sustainability Expertise: Translate sustainability frameworks (e.g., ESG reporting, circular economy, carbon reduction) into actionable product initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with sustainability leads, business stakeholders, and technical teams to define and prioritize sustainable product opportunities.
  • Product Vision & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of digital products and services that support responsible business practices and long-term resilience.
  • Innovation & Research: Identify emerging sustainability trends and technologies and integrate them into product discovery and development processes.
  • Establish and scale design systems, frameworks, and patterns while guiding when and how teams should extend beyond existing systems to meet evolving product and business needs.
  • Tackle system-level challenges—including AI-powered and data-intensive experiences—using systems thinking and a forward-looking perspective on how emerging technologies shape user interactions.
  • Mentor, coach, and elevate design teams while championing design excellence, setting a high bar for modern, high-quality design craft, and advocating for design’s strategic impact with senior and executive stakeholders.

What you must have:
  • 10–15 years of product management experience, including senior or principal-level roles.
  • Experience with products in sustainability-focused domains, such as energy, mobility, supply chain, circular economy, or ESG data and reporting.
  • Deep understanding of sustainability frameworks, including SDGs, net-zero strategies, carbon accounting, or ESG principles.
  • Ability to bridge the gap between business strategy, environmental objectives, and user experience.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working with agile design methodologies.

Nice to Have:
  • Experience consulting with Fortune 500 or global enterprise clients on sustainability or ESG transformation.
  • Knowledge of sustainability reporting standards such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, or GHG Protocol.
  • Familiarity with impact measurement tools, lifecycle analysis, or sustainable innovation frameworks.
  • Background in digital transformation or service design projects with environmental or social impact.

Our methodology:
  • Discover, imagine, create and deliver products and services that make things better for our clients, their customers, their employees and the world.
  • Bring together insight, creativity and technology to deliver experiences that transform our clients’ businesses.
  • Outcome driven, embody objectivity and people-centricity in everything we do.
  • Continuous discovery, delivery and learning through a collaborative, iterative design process.
  • Champion experimentation, conceptual thinking and creative expression in design.
  • Thought leadership in experience, design, branding and design systems through contributing to conferences and industry panels.


Our values:
We aspire to the qualities of intelligence, drive humility and imagination, they defines us as individuals, as teams and as one business and moves us from being good to great. You can read more about the kind of people we are and the behaviours we exhibit here:
https://www.foolproof.co.uk/culture/


Indigo Slate is a full-service human experience company. We are a digital organization backed by a global engineering leader, and we’re dedicated to helping clients build transformative experiences from start to finish. We create smart experiences that deliver powerful results through a profound intersection of marketing, technology, business, and creative. We understand that brands are no longer judged through their advertising, but through each touchpoint, both internal and external, building strength with every experience.

At Indigo Slate, we harness a mix of skills unique in our industry—equal parts strategic consultancy, creative agency, and technology thought leadership—to build and run some of the best experiences on the planet.

title: Senior Metallurgist

Who We Are
We are Vale Base Metals – a global supplier of the critical minerals transforming the future.
With industry-leading reserves of copper and nickel in Canada, Brazil, and Indonesia, and state-of-the-art infrastructure in the U.K., Canada, and Japan, VBM delivers a secure and responsible supply of high-quality products to customers across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.
Global demand for critical minerals is growing exponentially. From energy to aerospace, batteries to magnets, robotics to artificial intelligence, a secure and responsible supply of critical minerals is fundamental to power modern technologies. And at Vale Base Metals, we are transforming our business to provide a secure and responsible supply of these minerals.
Join our diverse team of 13,000 talented individuals committed to providing mineral security to a world in transition. We invite you to put your skills to work, driving meaningful and enduring change while enjoying a rewarding career.
The Opportunity
We are currently seeking a Senior Metallurgist to join our Concentrator Technical Services Team in Thompson, Manitoba.
This is a permanent position. Relocation to Thompson is required.
As a Sr. Metallurgist you will provide specialized knowledge to meet the commitments established for the role. Your experience and skills in developing and implementing process improvements, troubleshooting metallurgical challenges, and supporting operational performance will contribute to safe, reliable, and efficient production.

title: Sr. Director of Product Management
description:
Sr. Director of Product Management

This is a Remote position, #LI-Remote.

No visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa (H1-B, Student visa, or OPT visa) at this time.

At Lexipol, our mission is to create safer communities and empower the individuals on the front lines with market-leading content and technology. Our top-notch team works closely with law enforcement, fire, EMS, corrections, and local government professionals to tailor our solutions to better address today’s challenges and keep first responders coming home safely at the end of each shift.

Working at Lexipol means making a difference – day in and day out.

The Work
Lexipol is seeking a Senior Director of Product Management to lead the strategy, positioning, and lifecycle management of our Policy product portfolio spanning software and content products. This is a senior leadership role that sits at the intersection of market strategy, product vision, and organizational execution. You will be accountable for driving portfolio-level growth and ensuring our products deliver measurable outcomes for public safety organizations across the country.
You will lead and develop a team of product managers and technical product owners, setting the standard for product excellence across the organization. This role requires someone who can operate confidently at the senior level — shaping strategy, influencing stakeholders, and building the organizational capability needed to deliver market-leading products. You will report to the VP of Product Management and serve as a key voice in product leadership conversations across the company.

What You’ll Own

Product Strategy & Market Leadership

  • Define and own the multi-year product strategy, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives, evolving market dynamics, and customer needs in the public safety sector.
  • Lead competitive intelligence, market segmentation, and customer research programs to identify whitespace opportunities and inform strategic positioning.
  • Develop product positioning and messaging frameworks in partnership with product marketing to ensure differentiated market presence.
  • Drive pricing strategy across the product portfolio, balancing revenue growth, profitability, and competitive positioning, with recommendations delivered to executive leadership.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of product managers and technical product owners, establishing a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, customer obsession, and continuous learning.
  • Define and uphold standards for product management craft across the team — from discovery and requirements to delivery and measurement.
  • Build team capacity and capability to scale with the organization’s growth, including hiring, onboarding, and performance management.
  • Serve as a cross-functional leader who aligns engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success around shared goals and priorities.

Portfolio Roadmap & Prioritization

  • Own the strategic product roadmap across the Policy portfolio, driving prioritization decisions that balance near-term revenue impact with long-term competitive positioning.
  • Lead efforts around opportunity assessment, business case development, and ROI measurement for new product investments.
  • Identify and develop organic growth opportunities, including adjacent market expansion, new buyer segments, and platform extensions.
  • Support partnership evaluation and integration as a subject matter expert on product portfolio fit and capability gaps.

Product Development Oversight

  • Partner with SMEs, engineering and design leadership to ensure effective end-to-end product development, from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Establish standards for requirements definition, user story quality, and acceptance criteria across the product team.
  • Oversee alpha, beta, and pilot programs for new products and features, ensuring structured learning and feedback loops.
  • Define and govern the KPI framework for portfolio performance, product adoption, and customer outcomes.

Go-to-Market & Revenue Execution

  • Collaborate with sales, product marketing, marketing, and customer success to develop and execute go-to-market plans that drive new sales, expansions, and renewals.
  • Guide the sales and customer success teams on product positioning, competitive differentiation, and customer value narratives.
  • Align product launches and roadmap communications to revenue targets and customer satisfaction metrics.

What We’re Looking For

Required:
  • 10–15 years of SaaS product management experience, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role managing product managers and/or product teams.
  • Demonstrated track record of defining and executing portfolio-level product strategy for B2B or B2G SaaS products.
  • Proven experience in pricing strategy, product positioning, and competitive analysis in a dynamic market.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to C-suite.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, including the ability to build business cases, define KPI frameworks, and translate data into strategic recommendations.
  • Deep experience in Agile/Scrum product development methodologies and product management tooling.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and scale high-performance product teams.
  • Experience integrating AI capabilities into product strategy and/or technology products.

Preferred:
  • Background in public safety, government, or adjacent regulated markets.
  • Agile certifications: Agile Scrum Product Owner, Scaled Agile, or PMI-ACP.
  • Pragmatic Marketing certification.
  • MBA preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • Portfolio revenue and customer satisfaction targets are met or exceeded year over year.
  • Your product managers and technical product owners are growing, delivering with high quality, and operating with increasing independence.
  • NPS scores and product KPIs trend positively, with clear ownership and action plans behind each metric.
  • Product strategy is clearly understood and championed across the organization.
  • You are recognized as a trusted strategic partner by executive and cross-functional leaders.

Why This Role

  • High organizational visibility — you will present to and partner directly with C-suite leadership on a regular basis.
  • A genuine leadership platform — you will shape how product management operates at Lexipol, not just execute within it.
  • Meaningful work — the products you build directly support first responders who protect communities every day.
  • A collaborative, remote-first environment with flexibility and core-hours availability across US time zones.
  • You will report to the VP of Product Management, who will serve as a champion and thought partner in your continued leadership development.

Compensation & Benefits

Lexipol offers a competitive base salary, annual incentive, and a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k) with company match and flexible paid time off.
Base salary for this role starts at $175,000 and higher, depending on experience, plus annual bonus.


About Lexipol
Lexipol empowers first responders and public servants to best meet the needs of their residents safely and responsibly. We are the experts in policy, training and wellness support, committed to improving the quality of life for all community members. Our solutions include state-specific policies, online learning, behavioral health resources, grant assistance, and industry news and information offered through the websites Police1, FireRescue1, EMS1, Corrections1 and Gov1. Lexipol serves more than 2 million public safety and government professionals in over 12,000 agencies and municipalities. For additional information, visit .

Lexipol complies with applicable federal, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities.
