title: Intelligence Analyst (who want FMV Training)
description:
Geo Owl is looking for dynamic professionals to join our team.

At Geo Owl, we take pride in supporting the critical missions that protect our nation, our freedoms, and our families—the things that truly matter. We are seeking motivated individuals eager to launch or advance an exciting career in intelligence while supporting global counterterrorism operations.

If you are a military trained intelligence professional, we are offering a unique chance for you to train in another trade craft. Prior military training and experience is required for this role to be considered.

You will receive comprehensive hands-on training across all intelligence disciplines, earn advanced skills certifications, and have opportunities for rapid career progression into instructor, subject matter expert, or management positions.

For current FMV-qualified professionals, this program offers enhanced training designed to build on and expand your existing expertise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop FMV tradecraft skills through a three-week formal training course followed by a robust on-the-job training program, including:

    • Specialized instruction in FMV exploitation tools

    • Motion GEOINT techniques

    • Theater-specific cultural familiarization

  • Analyze and exploit FMV collected by ISR platforms, applying HUMINT and SIGINT to produce actionable intelligence.

  • Create and distribute imagery-derived graphic products and reports for senior decision-makers across government agencies.

  • Compile and prepare intelligence materials to support high-level briefings.

  • Leverage advanced imagery tools, including electronic light tables, to exploit national technical means (NTM) imagery.

  • Access career development opportunities on day one, including generous paid time off, education benefits, and structured advancement pathways.

  • Explore rapid career progression, with potential cross-training into Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), Ground Moving Target Indicator (GMTI), FMV instruction, and FMV advanced research roles.

Who You Are

  • Flexible and dependable, able to work a rotating shift schedule (7am–7pm or 7pm–7am) that alternates days and nights monthly, including weekends and holidays.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment, with strong multitasking skills.

  • A clear, effective communicator.

  • Experienced in intelligence operations, especially the TCPED (Tasking, Collection, Processing, Exploitation, and Dissemination) process.

  • Proactive about learning new skills and expanding your analytic and technical capabilities.

  • Collaborative and innovative, able to solve problems creatively in partnership with government customers.

  • In possession of an active TS/SCI security clearance, with the ability to pass a polygraph examination.

Required Education, Experience & Skills

  • Experience: 3+ years in intelligence roles OR a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a customer-approved discipline.

  • Training: Completion of a formal intelligence school course (typically 3+ months full time) resulting in an Intelligence MOS (e.g., All-Source, IMINT, SIGINT, HUMINT).

  • Technical Skills:

    • Ability to type at least 32 words per minute with 90% accuracy without looking at the keyboard.

    • Understanding of the basic intelligence cycle/process.

    • Ability to accurately distinguish red, green, blue, and yellow on video screens.

  • Clearance: Active TS/SCI clearance and ability to successfully complete a polygraph.

Preferred Education, Experience & Skills

  • Basic understanding of national-level imagery production standards.

  • Familiarity with FMV exploitation and sensor capabilities.

  • Experience analyzing national imagery.

  • Ability to relay and articulate information effectively during high-tempo operations.

  • Background in counterterrorism analysis.

  • Proficiency solving routine tasks of varying complexity using established procedures.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Join Geo Owl to grow your career, develop specialized expertise, and support missions of national significance.


Benefits:

​

Health Insurance (Geo Owl pays 80%+ of the premium).

401k matching.

Dental, Vision, and other supplemental insurance plans available.

Company-paid short-term and long-term disability and life insurance.

Peer-to-Peer spot bonuses.

120 hours of PTO per year plus federal holidays.

Fully Paid Military Leave: *You make your full Geo Owl salary while you are on military duty*

Exiting the Military? Apply to our Military Transition Program for key insights into making the transition to civilian life from people who have been there before!

Engage with Your Team!

​

About Us:

Our mission is to empower EVERYONE with geospatial technologies.

Geo Owl is a premier provider of geospatial intelligence services, delivering cutting-edge solutions to the Department of Defense, intelligence agencies, and enterprises around the globe. Our comprehensive products and services include advanced geospatial analysis, imagery intelligence, remote sensing analysis, data science, and space-based custom intelligence solutions. At Geo Owl, we are dedicated to leveraging the latest analytic principles and technology to support and enhance the missions of our clients.

Our core values—innovation, integrity, and excellence—drive everything we do. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of geospatial intelligence to ensure our clients receive the most accurate, timely, and actionable intelligence possible. Integrity is at the heart of our operations; we uphold the highest standards of ethics and accountability in our work. Striving for excellence is not just a goal but a standard; we consistently aim to exceed expectations in every project.

Geo Owl's culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and respect. We cultivate an environment where team members can grow both personally and professionally. Our team is composed of passionate, dedicated experts who are always ready to support each other. We value work-life balance, offering flexible working arrangements and a supportive workplace where everyone feels valued.

At Geo Owl, we invest in our employees' growth and development. We provide ongoing training, career advancement opportunities, and a platform to work on impactful projects that make a real difference. Our team enjoys a strong sense of camaraderie and purpose, knowing that their work contributes to national security and global stability. If you are looking for a dynamic, rewarding career in geospatial intelligence, Geo Owl is the place for you. Join us and be part of a team that is shaping the future of geospatial intelligence.

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction.

Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

To use your academic knowledge of architectural fundamentals to contribute to our projects

Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Actively pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree within Urban/Landscape Architecture field or similar.

Sustainability, materials & reuse

BIM, Revit, design & sketching

Competitions & visualizations

Descriptions & quality assurance

Urban Planning


These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

A place to work and so much more

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

title: Registration Specialist
location: WVU Heart & Vascular Institute Dorothy McCormack Center
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

Performs a variety of administrative and clerical duties to manage patient registration and patient financial obligation.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:
1. High school graduate or equivalent.
2. State criminal background check and Federal (if applicable), as required for regulated areas.

CORE JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Obtains demographic/billing/insurance information from patient/family/legal guardian and enters into the registration/billing systems for service and claim processing and scans insurance cards & photo identification. Provides to the patient, information concerning insurance, payment of bills and hospital procedures.
2. May complete managed care responsibilities in regard to obtaining pre-certification and authorizations.
3. Prepares WVU Medicine standard consent form, notice of privacy practice and/or other necessary paperwork related to registration and presents to patient/family/legal guardian for signatures. Obtains electronic signature for consent to treat and patient financial obligations.
4. Collects deposits/co-payments/deductibles/patient liability payments when applicable, provides patient receipt and documents payment in the registration/billing systems.
5. Prepares armband for patient identification.
6. Balances daily receipts and cash drawer for patient payments as needed. Follows up on accounts as indicated by system flags (courtesy dismissal/comments/red stickers).
7. May initiate various screenings and obtains all pertinent information for coverage and completes appropriate paperwork.
8. Performs medical necessity checks and completes Advanced Beneficiary Notice as needed.
9. Schedules, reschedules, or cancels patients in accordance with hospital workflows.
10. Checks for order completeness and validate order against scheduled service.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Frequent walking, standing, stooping, kneeling, reaching, pushing, pulling, lifting, and grasping.
2. Visual acuity must be within normal range.
3. Manual dexterity to operate keyboards, fax machines, telephones, and other business equipment.
4. Sitting and/or standing for extended periods of time.
5. Reading and comprehension ability.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. High volume, fast paced environment.
2. Exposure to communicable disease.
3. Frequent interactions with patients, medical staff, and support staff daily on a continual basis.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

1. Ability to accurately utilize applicable computer software and equipment for access processing & demonstrates ability to follow down time procedures.
2. Demonstrate knowledge of procedure to report and/or document unsafe/hazardous conditions, incidents and defective equipment in compliance with hospital policy.
3. Requires considerable attention to detail, the ability to be organized and to be able to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.
4. Requires the ability to memorize a considerable amount of information, and to be able to reference information not retained from written sources or from appropriate personnel.
5. Requires the ability to understand medical insurance requirements for payment and basic knowledge of covered services.
6. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to understand written and verbal communication.
7. Basic knowledge of medical terminology.

title: MDR Security Analyst
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a MDR Analyst you will be tasked with Joining our Vigilance organization, an elite force of cybersecurity experts delivering a Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service to our largest customers. You'll help drive a world-class threat monitoring, hunting, and response service, playing an integral role in a 24x7 follow-the-sun global SOC.

You will work closely with key points of contact (POCs) and customers to provide an additional layer of security and confidence — leveraging intelligence feeds, threat logs, and IOCs (Indicators of Compromise) to detect and respond to threats effectively.

You'll also collaborate with our world-class threat research team and various R&D groups, helping to shape our product, keep customers more secure, and establish your presence within the broader cyber tech ecosystem.

What will you do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Proactively monitor and review threats and suspicious events from customers participating in the service Investigate alerts, triage, deep dive, and come up with proper action items and remediation plans.
  • Use multiple sources of data from the customer, our intelligence cloud, external threat feeds, etc.
  • Perform proactive hunting for threat data, leveraging our deep visibility abilities and proprietary research cloud.
  • Work with the customer to follow up on items that require additional investigation.
  • Provide Incident follow-up & support
  • Maintain excellent customer satisfaction through professional, proactive, and personal service
  • Work closely with our research and development team
  • Contribute to our knowledge base by creating malware analysis cookbooks and best practices

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 1-3 years of experience with Technical Support, SOC, IR, Malware Analysis, or IT Security is a must
  • Strong network and security knowledge is desired
  • Experience with SQL, bash, python, and powershell
  • Professional and articulate with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize
  • Multi-OS support experience: Windows, Mac & Linux (mobile platforms - an advantage)
  • Experience with incident response, computer forensic investigations, or threat hunting is a plus
  • Experience with host base (endpoint agent), or sandbox (network-based) security solutions is an advantage
  • Be able to work a fluid and dynamic schedule to cover hours and days outside of the normal work week

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Competitive leave benefits
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Employee Assistant Program
  • Workout sessions and a Wellness App

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical and insurance benefits
  • Pension
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Global home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement
  • Study Fund

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

title: Associate Personal Bankers - Albuquerque, NM area
description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking new Associate Personal Bankers (SAFE) to join our National Branch Network within in the Albuquerque area. In this frontline role, you will build relationships with customers by supporting everyday banking needs through in‑branch interactions, scheduled conversations, and proactive outreach. You will learn about customers’ goals and connect them to the right banking products, services, and digital tools to help them manage their finances with confidence.

You will support account openings, service requests, and credit applications while working closely with branch teammates to deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. Success is driven by strong relationship building, sound judgment, and the ability to balance service with growth.

As a member of a leading financial institution, this role provides a strong foundation for long-term career growth and mobility, supported by Wells Fargo’s training and coaching.

In this role you will:

  • Build lasting customer relationships through proactive, meaningful conversations that support financial well-being and deepen engagement

  • Lead discovery-driven conversations to understand customer needs and connect them with relevant banking products, services, and solutions

  • Drive branch growth by identifying opportunities, promoting solutions, and making appropriate referrals to meet customer and business goals

  • Support everyday banking needs, including new account openings, service requests, and credit applications

  • Perform cash handling and teller line activities, accurately processing transactions while maintaining compliance and operational standards

  • Demonstrate comfort using and adopting digital tools and technologies to enhance the customer experience and support evolving banking needs

  • Deliver accurate, compliant service while exercising sound judgement within defined risk controls

  • Collaborate with branch teammates to coordinate seamless handoffs to licensed bankers or other specialists, ensuring customers are connected to the right expertise

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ months of interacting with customers experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in financial services or a highly regulated, customer-facing role, demonstrating comfort with structured processes, accuracy, and service expectations

  • Experience building trust-based customer relationships through active listening, follow-up, and consistent engagement

  • Comfort initiating outreach (calls, emails, or other channels) to strengthen relationships and identify opportunities to support customer needs

  • Demonstrated comfort with digital tools and technology, with the ability to quickly learn new systems and confidently guide customers in adopting capabilities that enhance their banking experience

  • Ability to identify customer needs and connect them to appropriate solutions, including referrals when additional expertise is needed

  • Proven ability to collaborate with teammates and partners to resolve needs and deliver a seamless customer experience

  • Demonstrated ability to follow policies and regulations while identifying and escalating risk concerns

Job Expectations:

  • Ability to work a schedule that will include Saturdays

  • Support branch operations by flexing between cash handling and customer banking activities, with an emphasis on delivering strong service through account openings and ongoing account support.

  • SAFE registration is required at the time of employment and Wells Fargo will initiate the process after your start date. Loan Originators must meet LO/CFPB requirements and comply with Wells Fargo policies, including standards related to financial responsibility, character, fitness, and criminal background. A credit report may be reviewed (credit score not included) and additional ongoing screening may apply.

  • This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

Locations include:

  • Albuquerque
  • Portales
  • Clove
  • Bernalillo
  • Rio Rancho

Posting End Date:

30 Aug 2026

*Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

Applicants with Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

Drug and Alcohol Policy

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

Job Title: Director of Hospitality: Environments

Department: Hospitality

Reports to: Senior Executive Pastor, Senior Pastor

Status: Full-Time | Hourly

Schedule: Sunday – Thursday | 30-40 hours

Supervisory role: No

Last updated: 07.21.2026

New Life Church's mission is to make disciples in the Pikes Peak region, by calling people to worship, connect and serve.

Job Summary:

The Director of Hospitality: Environments will cultivate a culture of intentional hospitality by creating warm, inviting, and well-prepared environments where every guest, congregant, volunteer, and staff member experiences authentic welcome and meaningful connection. This role will create spaces and experiences that foster friendship, community, and belonging, encouraging deeper engagement in the life of the church. The Director of Hospitality: Environments will also support the relational ministry of the Senior Pastor by welcoming and hosting guests, thoughtfully preparing gifts and expressions of care, creating meaningful opportunities for connection, and ensuring that each interaction reflects the heart and values of the Senior Pastor through intentional hospitality and excellence.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and lead a comprehensive environmental hospitality strategy that cultivates a culture of welcome, friendship, and connection throughout New Life.
  • Establish clear practices and standards that ensure consistency of welcome, connection, and invitation across gatherings, events, and ministry environments.
  • Create and maintain welcoming environments that reflect intentionality, preparation, and care across events, ministry gatherings, and weekend services at New Life North.
  • Partner with ministry leaders and staff to provide support in the settings, systems, and standards of welcome and hospitality for church-wide events, programs, and special gatherings.
  • Recruit, train, equip, schedule, and encourage volunteers to serve effectively and represent the culture of hospitality in the church.
  • Collaborate with facilities and operations teams to ensure gathering spaces are prepared, functional, and reflective of the church’s commitment to hospitality.
  • Manage resources, supplies, and budget with thoughtful stewardship and attention to detail.
  • Evaluate hospitality practices regularly and implement improvements that strengthen the overall experience of guests, congregants, volunteers, and staff.
  • Coordinate hospitality elements for staff meetings, retreats, trainings, and internal gatherings connected to the Senior Pastor and church leadership as needed.
  • Support the relational ministry of the Senior Pastor by coordinating meaningful touchpoints, hosting guests, preparing thoughtful gifts, and creating opportunities for connection.
  • Serve as a welcoming presence on behalf of the Senior Pastor, helping ensure key relationships, guests, and ministry partners feel cared for and valued.
  • Manage and respond to calls and emails as needed.
  • Communicate regularly with supervisor about departmental issues.
  • Assist supervisor with special projects, events, and diverse tasks in support of the department.
  • Attend department meetings, regular all-staff meetings and other meetings as required.
  • Utilize a thorough understanding of New Life Church employee policies and procedures.
  • Work in close association with the entire staff to build and maintain a strong team environment.
  • Cooperate with leadership by performing any other duties when asked to do so.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion, integrity, and sound judgment.
  • Knowledge of administrative and office management practices, including scheduling, communication workflows, document organization, and basic office operations.
  • Understanding of professional communication standards, including email etiquette, interdepartmental communication, and confidentiality protocols.
  • Familiarity with church ministry environments, organizational structures, and seasonal rhythms.
  • Knowledge of event coordination fundamentals, including preparation, communication, hospitality support, and follow-up.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prepare materials, coordinate details, anticipate needs, and ensure consistent follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt quickly to changing needs, and remain calm and effective under pressure.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify issues, analyze situations, and develop practical solutions with minimal supervision.
  • High level of professionalism, reliability, and personal accountability.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact tactfully and effectively at all levels.
  • Ability to represent pastoral leadership and the church with warmth, hospitality, and a ministry-minded attitude.
  • Ability to work independently while thriving in a collaborative, team-based environment.
  • Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to manage interruptions while maintaining accuracy and focus.
  • Proficiency with common office and communication tools, including Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) or equivalent platforms.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and complete projects with limited guidance

Education and Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience in administration, communications, or ministry support.
  • Experience:
    • 3 - 5+ years of professional experience in executive-level support, administration, event planning, or related fields.
    • Experience in church, nonprofit, or ministry environments is highly preferred.
    • Demonstrated ability to support senior leadership with a mix of administrative, operational, and relational responsibilities.
    • Experience managing calendars, meetings, correspondence, and communications for senior leaders.
    • Experience coordinating events, retreats, or staff gatherings, including preparation, follow-up, and hospitality considerations.
    • Proficiency with office software, communication platforms, and digital tools appropriate to the role.

Working Conditions and Requirements of Office Environment:

Physical Demands

  • Regularly required to sit and occasionally required to stand and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must be able to frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
  • Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Close visual acuity to is necessary to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Anretning

Klargøring til møder

Bestilling af mad m.m.

Rengøring på kontor, omklædning og køkkenet

Andre ad hoc-opgaver

Du har erfaring med rengøring og service og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

Mulighed for at leje attraktive ferieboliger i både ind- og udland (fx Lalandia og Østrig).

Det betyder, at vi tager ansvar for at sikre, at der er gjort ordentligt rent og vedligeholdt så vi leverer kvalitetsservice hos vores kunder. Your job is more than a job.

Let’s tell it like it is. Med-Surg nursing is the backbone of every hospital, and it’s not for everyone. Thankfully, you’re not everyone. You love being on the front line of care and getting to know your patients as real people.

You sweat the small stuff and bring all you’ve got to every patient’s bedside, call light, hand hold, chart entry, medical need, team request, family request and yes, even the proverbial Jello request. You love the range of nursing skills it demands, and that there’s “never-a-dull-moment”. And that’s what we love about you.

Your experiences, knowledge, skills, empathy, compassion, and your “little something extra” all add up to you. And we’re excited to get to know you and find out what you’ll bring to this hands-on, diverse nursing role.

Take the lead: prioritizing, coordinating, and delegating all care touchpoints for your patients.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary team members to ensure appropriate direct patient care.

Maintain and advocate a safe environment for everyone.

Monitor and engage with your patients, families, and appropriate care team members concerning significant events, patient condition changes, or patient questions and concerns.

Prevent and treat wounds.

Monitor and execute Joint Commission infection control and environment of care requirements.

Ensure continuity of care, efficient throughput, consistent communications, and an exceptional experience for every patient.

Advise and consult with supervisor when unable to complete assignments or perform tasks promptly, effectively, or safely.

Initiate patient and family education using appropriate resources and continuum of care services.

Contribute to the team by assisting others without being asked.

Current nursing license to practice in Louisiana and as defined by the Louisiana State Board of Nursing.

Current American Heart Association BLS certification.

Days (United States of America)

University Medical Center, a world class academic medical center in LCMC Health’s incredible community of care, is the largest medical training center for healthcare professionals in Louisiana and has long served as the region’s safety net hospital for poor and underserved communities for 300+. title: Data Scientist (MMM)
description:
FocusKPI is seeking smart, curious, technically savvy, and experienced candidates to join our cutting-edge internal data science team. The data science team at FocusKPI builds models and machine learning algorithms that power all our clients' ad-tech/mar-tech products at scale, develops methodologies and tools to precisely and effectively measure market and campaign effects, and researches in-house and public data sources for insights into consumer spending behavior.

In this role, you'll spearhead the company's advanced predictive modeling and analytics to elevate its analytical capabilities. In addition, you'll be expected to play an essential role in executing the R&D agenda and delivering products on time and to high quality for different businesses.

Work Location: Remote - anywhere in the US
Duration: Full-time/Part-time position
Pay Range: $90k+/annum

Responsibilities:
  • Support clients' modeling needs, including maintenance, enhancement of existing measurement and targeting solutions, and timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Developing innovative and automated solutions for custom needs, leveraging appropriate AI/ML/statistical tools.
  • Mine large consumer datasets in the cloud environment to support ad hoc business and statistical analysis.
  • Provide analytical/statistical support for marketing test design, campaign measurement, and market insights to clients and stakeholders.
  • Communicate methodologies and results to management, clients, and other non-technical stakeholders.
Qualifications:
  • An advanced degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Mathematics/ Economics, or related fields, requires advanced training in data modeling and analytics.
  • Ph.D. degree in statistics/mathematics, engineering, computer science, economics, or a related field
  • Deep understanding and solid knowledge of the fundamentals of statistical reasoning and ML models.
  • Experience with causal inference, marketing mix models (MMM), and multi-touch attribution models is highly valued and mandatory to have
  • An added advantage is familiarity with deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and generative AI.
  • Skilled in conceptualizing complex business problems and designing practical, effective modeling and analytical solutions to address them.
  • Proficiency in common programming languages such as Python and SQL.
  • Experienced and comfortable working with standard big data tools, including cloud platforms, database technologies, and parallel processing frameworks.
  • Entrepreneurial, highly self-motivated, collaborative, keen attention to detail, willing and capable to learn quickly, and effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a demanding environment.
  • Great communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation).

Thank you!

FocusKPI Hiring Team

Founded in 2010, FocusKPI, Inc. (FocusKPI) is a data science and technology firm specializing in predictive analytics practice and methodologies. FocusKPI is a US company headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, with an East Coast office in Boston, Massachusetts.

NOTICE: Please be aware of fraudulent emails regarding job postings, job offers and fake checks. FocusKPI's recruiting team will strictly reach out via @focuskpi.com email domain. If you have received fraudulent emails now or in the past, please report it to https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/ .
The domain @focuskpijobs.com is fraudulent and not related to FocusKPI. Please do not not reply or communicate to anyone with @focuskpijobs.com.

description:

Job Title: Specialist, Systems/Software Quality Engineer

Job Code: 41499

Job Location: Salt Lake City

Job Schedule: 9/80 employees work 9 out of 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off

Job Description:

The Systems and Software Quality Engineer function is a program focused role that is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing Software Quality Assurance standards, methods, and procedures to ensure software products and services meet contractual, regulatory, and industry requirements. Verifies software and firmware process compliance through collaboration with engineering, operations, and program management across the full product lifecycle. Conducts internal audits to ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements, and standards such as ISO 9001, AS9100, and AS9115. Analyzes quality data to identify risks and drive continuous improvement.

Essential Functions:

·Support configuration management, verification, and validation activities as required to ensure software product quality.

·Develop, implement, and maintain software quality assurance (SQA) processes, procedures, and quality management system documentation.

·Verify compliance with approved software development plans, processes, standards, and configuration management requirements.

·Provide independent oversight of software development lifecycle activities, including requirements, design, coding, integration, verification, validation, release, and maintenance.

·Review software lifecycle artifacts for completeness, traceability, and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

·Collaborate with engineering, systems engineering, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and program management to ensure quality requirements are integrated throughout the product lifecycle.

·Analyze quality metrics, audit results, and nonconformance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

·Support internal, customer, regulatory, and third-party audits by providing objective evidence of compliance.

·Conduct process, product, and quality management system audits; document findings and verify corrective actions.

·Participate in design reviews, milestone reviews, and readiness assessments to ensure quality objectives are achieved.

·Identify and escalate quality risks that may impact product performance, certification, schedule, or customer satisfaction.

·Maintain compliance with company policies, export control regulations, safety requirements, and ethical business practices

Qualifications:

·Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant quality experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related quality experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related quality experience.

·Working knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid development models.

·Experience implementing or auditing software quality processes in accordance with aerospace, defense, or other regulated industry standards [AS9115].

Are you currently studying to be an Construction Architecture (Bygningskonstruktør)? Then, join us to shape a sustainable and liveable world.

 

About us

Arkitema was established in 1969 making us one of Denmark's oldest architectural firms. Today, we are well positioned in Scandinavia with offices in Denmark, Norway and Sweden.

In our markets we provide wide range of competencies in our areas of expertise. We cover sectors and disciplines like healthcare, industry, transformation, landscape and residential construction. 

Since 2019 Arkitema has been part of COWI, one of Scandinavia’s leading engineering and consultancy companies. Together with customers, partners and colleagues, we shape a future where people and societies grow and flourish. We do that by co-creating more sustainable and beautiful solutions that improve the quality of life for people today and many generations ahead.


Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow 

As an intern at Arkitema, you will be part of a design team in one of Scandinavia's largest and leading architectural firms, where you will work with experienced architects, construction architects, urban planners and engineers to solve a wide range of professionally relevant tasks.

Your key responsibilities will be: 

To use your academic knowledge of technical fundamentals to contribute to our projects

Gain valuable experience in the field of architecture and construction

 

Also, you will be included in a team and assigned an experienced colleague as a mentor who will guide you throughout your internship. We carry out architecture primarily throughout the Nordic region but also other parts of the world within the areas of; Housing, Learning, Business, Health, Urban, Culture and Infrastructure. Therefore, our assignments range from small preservation-worthy residential neighborhoods to complex super hospitals, bridges and cultural centers.

As an intern, you will have the opportunity to be involved in drawing the first lines, registering old building masses, supervising construction sites on ongoing projects, or modeling and detailing the many complex buildings. Our professional span will give you a broad understanding of the design profession and in-depth knowledge of the workflows in the construction industry.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.
The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners, or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve. 

On top of that, you’ll have: 

Actively pursuing a bachelor’s degree in architectural technology and construction management (Bygningskonstruktør)

Have good problem-solving skills 

Be a creative and technical thinker 

Be able to demonstrate evidence of research and information gathering skills 

 

Professional development

We strive to develop talented interns who graduate with a high level of professional skills. As part of the internship at Arkitema, there are ongoing presentations where our own specialists share their experience and best practices in topics such as:

Sustainability, materials & reuse

BIM, Revit, design & sketching

Client consultancy & tendering

Restoration & building preservation

Competitions & visualizations

Descriptions & quality assurance

Urban Planning


These topics represent important knowledge and practical insights that will ensure you stand stronger in your future career.

A place to work and so much more
At Arkitema, we work together with our customers to shape sustainable and customized solutions. By making use of our collective knowledge and curiosity, we create opportunities that contribute to good solutions for a future with ever-changing needs.

We want to develop an environment where curiosity, belonging and good chemistry are in focus.

For us, it is important that the people we share everyday work with are allowed to be themselves, precisely because it is what brings out the best in you and those around us, both at work and at home.

If you have any unanswered questions about the role, please reach out Jacob Faaborg-Simonsen - jafs@arkitema.com for Aarhus/Aalborg and Adrian Balch Petersen - adpn@arkitema.com for Copenhagen.

Get to know us even better at our website, Arkitema where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at Arkitema.

Senior Test Automation Engineer (Non-Human Identity)






Alicante, Spain · Hybrid · Permanent



About Omada Identity

Omada Identity is a leading cloud-based Identity Governance and Administration platform. We help enterprises ensure that the right people and the right non-human identities have the right access to the right resources, at the right time.

We work with security-conscious enterprises across regulated industries. Our customers rely on us to govern access for tens of thousands of identities across hybrid environments. We are recognized by industry analysts as a leader in the IGA space. We are now investing in the fastest-growing identity category: Non-Human Identities (NHIs).



About the team and the mission

You will join a newly established team built to own Omada's Non-Human Identity product line. NHIs — agentic AI identities, machine identities, service accounts, and workloads — now outnumber humans 144:1 in modern enterprises and are growing roughly 44% per year. Governing them is becoming a deal-blocker in competitive evaluations. Omada has a working prototype already in customer hands.

Your mission is to turn that prototype into a product that customers adopt, renew, and expand. That means getting to production-grade — secure, scalable, multi-tenant, CI/CD-managed — and then building the evidence that the market wants: adoption data, customer outcomes, and pipeline influence.



We work in a fully agentic SDLC. AI-assisted development is the default working mode across the team, end to end. Stories, design, implementation, review, and testing all leverage AI agents. We expect candidates to bring real experience with agentic development, not just curiosity.

This is a foundational opportunity. You will join early enough to shape the team, the technical direction, and the working practices that will scale with the product.



About the role



You'll become one of the founding members of our new Non-Human Identity engineering team. Rather than maintaining manual test cases, you'll design and implement the automated qualiy platform that enables fast, reliable delivery. You'll work closely with software engineers, Product Owners and Engineering Manager to define strategy, build automation frameworks, improve CI/CD pipelines and ensure every release meets the security, scalability and reliability standards expected from an enterprise identity platform. Quality is a shared responsibility across the team, and you'll be the engineering expert helping us make automated testing a competitive advantage. 



What you'll do



	
Design and build automated testing frameworks for backend services, frontend applications and APIs

	
Develop end-to-end automated test suites covering critical customer journeys

	
Build intergration and contract tests for indentity provider integrations and external APIs

	
Automate regression testing within CI/CD pipelines

	
Develop performance, load and reliability testing strategies

	
Validate multi-tenant behaviour, tenant isolation and deployment automation

	
Design automated security validation together with engineering teams

	
Improve test reporting, observability and release confidence

	
Collaborate with engineers during feature development to ensure testability by design

	
Investigate production issues and strenghten automated test coverage to prevent regressions

	
Evaluate AI-assisted testing techniques and help integrate then into our engineering workflows

	
Continuously improve engineering quality metrics and release processes.




What we're looking for 



Required 



	
6+ years of experience in software test automation or Software Development Engineer in Test roles

	
Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript or another modern programming language

	
Experience building automated testing frameworks rather than only maintaining them

	
Experience testing REST APIs and distributed systems

	
Experience with modern frontend test automation (Playwright)

	
Experience with backend integration testing

	
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines

	
Experience testing cloud-native applications

	
Strong understanding of testing strategies across unit, integration, end-to-end and performance testing

	
Excellent debugging and analytical skills

	
Strong written and spoken English




Nice to have 



	
Node.js and Typescript

	
React applications

	
Playwright

	
Vitest or Jest

	
PostgreSQL

	
Docker and Kubernetes

	
Terraform and Infrastructure as Code 

	
Azure DevOps or Github Actions

	
Graph databases (Neo4j, Memgraph or similar)

	
Identity Governance, IAM or cybersecurity domian experience

	
OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SCIM and Microsoft Entra ID

	
Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS platforms

	
Experience working in AI-assisted software development environments




What we offer:



	
Being one of the founding members of the new feature team

	
Modern cloud-native technology stack. 

	
Opportunity to work on an innovative cybersecurity product. 

	
AI-first engineering culture. 




Join Our Journey  

If you’re a dedicated developer excited about building high-quality, secure cloud-native solutions in a collaborative, agile environment, we’d love to hear from you.  



Be part of our Alicante team and help shape the future of self-managed identity solutions - secure, flexible, and truly customer-driven. 



Omada is an equal opportunity employer and qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or any other protected class. 



At Omada, we are experts in cybersecurity, taking our customers by the hand, helping them to take identity and access management to the next level. We offer you the opportunity to work with passionate, competent people, experts within their field, in an informal and agile organization with a flat structure. We thrive on being challenged and everything we do is anchored in our core values of ambition, teamwork, constant care, and creating value. 



The Omada product is rated as one of the very best in the world by analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, and KuppingerCole and we have a high focus on keep developing our product to meet our customers’ business requirements.

title: FMV Intelligence Analyst
description:
Geo Owl · SDVOSB · Est. 2013

Full Motion Video (FMV) Analyst

FMV · MOTION GEOINT · COUNTERTERRORISM OPERATIONS

Some intelligence roles are about watching. This one is about seeing what matters, understanding why it matters, and helping decision-makers act with speed and confidence. As a Geo Owl FMV Analyst, you will build high-value motion GEOINT tradecraft, support global counterterrorism operations, and grow inside a team that takes the mission—and your development—seriously.

Role Overview

Geo Owl is looking for a motivated, dependable Full Motion Video Analyst to support time-sensitive intelligence missions in a high-tempo operational environment. In this role, you will analyze and exploit FMV collected by ISR platforms, integrate intelligence from multiple disciplines, produce imagery-derived reports and graphics, and help deliver actionable intelligence to senior Government decision-makers.

This opportunity is designed for both developing intelligence professionals and current FMV-qualified analysts. You will receive a three-week formal training course, robust on-the-job training, and structured opportunities to expand into advanced FMV, SAR, GMTI, instructor, research, subject matter expert, or management pathways.

Source-Derived Role Summary

The FMV Analyst develops and applies FMV tradecraft through formal training and on-the-job development; exploits ISR platform video; applies HUMINT and SIGINT context; produces imagery-derived graphics and reports; prepares intelligence materials for senior-level briefings; and supports global counterterrorism operations.

A Day in the Life

  • ✓Analyze live or recorded FMV from ISR platforms and identify mission-relevant activity, patterns, and anomalies.
  • ✓Fuse FMV observations with HUMINT, SIGINT, and broader intelligence context to support actionable assessments.
  • ✓Build imagery-derived graphic products, reports, and briefing materials that communicate findings clearly under operational timelines.
  • ✓Use FMV exploitation tools, electronic light tables, and national imagery sources to support precise analysis and reporting.
  • ✓Participate in formal training, OJT, and mission-specific familiarization to deepen motion GEOINT capability.
  • ✓Work rotating 12-hour shifts, including days, nights, weekends, and holidays, while maintaining accuracy, focus, and team communication.

Why This Role Matters

Mission Impact

Your analysis helps protect our nation, our freedoms, and the families behind them by turning ISR collection into intelligence that can inform real operational decisions.

Geo Owl Impact

Geo Owl is built around serious GEOINT tradecraft. This role strengthens the team’s ability to deliver precise, timely, mission-relevant products to customers who depend on clarity.

Your Growth

From day one, you will have access to training, certifications, structured advancement pathways, and potential cross-training into advanced FMV, SAR, GMTI, instruction, and research roles.

Core Responsibilities

  • ▸Develop FMV tradecraft through a three-week formal training course and a robust on-the-job training program.
  • ▸Exploit FMV collected by ISR platforms and apply HUMINT and SIGINT context to produce actionable intelligence.
  • ▸Create and distribute imagery-derived graphic products and reports for senior decision-makers across Government agencies.
  • ▸Compile, prepare, and communicate intelligence materials that support high-level briefings and operational understanding.
  • ▸Use advanced imagery tools, including electronic light tables, to exploit national technical means imagery.
  • ▸Support continuous improvement in analytic quality, reporting clarity, and customer mission support.

Required Qualifications

  • ✓Active TS/SCI security clearance and the ability to successfully complete a polygraph examination.
  • ✓Three or more years of intelligence experience, or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a customer-approved discipline.
  • ✓Completion of a formal intelligence school course, typically three or more months full time, resulting in an Intelligence MOS such as All-Source, IMINT, SIGINT, or HUMINT.

title: QA Engineer - Python, Automation
description:
Company Description

Genomics England is a global leader in enabling genomic medicine and research, focused on creating a world where everyone benefits from genomic healthcare. Building on the 100,000 Genomes Project, we support the NHS’s world-first national whole genome sequencing service and run the growing National Genomic Research Library, alongside delivering numerous major genomics initiatives. By connecting research and clinical care at national scale, we enable immediate healthcare benefits and advances for the future.

Our mission is to provide the evidence and digital systems so that by 2035 genomics could play a role in up to half of all healthcare interactions, whilst securing the UK’s position as the best place to discover, prove and benefit from genomic innovations.

We are accelerating our impact and working with patients, doctors, scientists, government and industry to improve genomic testing, and help researchers access the health data and technology they need to make new medical discoveries and create more effective, targeted medicines for everybody.

Behind the Healthcare and Research outcomes, Genomics England delivers through designing, developing and operating complex healthcare software systems.

We're on the cusp of big changes with the real prospect of genomics becoming the fabric of everyday healthcare through the lifetime - from birth to old age.

Job Description

QA Engineer - 12 Month FTC (Python)

At Genomics England, we’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer with strong commercial Python and test automation experience. You’ll play a key role in ensuring quality is engineered into our products from the outset, working closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, SMEs, and fellow QA Engineers to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure solutions.

Working as part of a cross-functional Agile squad, you'll champion a shift-left approach to quality, building and evolving automated testing frameworks using Python, while helping improve test coverage, automation, and delivery confidence across the software development lifecycle.

This is an opportunity to contribute to products that support Genomics England’s mission to transform healthcare through genomics. The work you do is meaningful and directly supports the delivery of high-quality digital services that enable world-leading genomic research and help improve real outcomes for patients and families across the UK.

Job Description:

The QA Engineer will:

  • Promote and follow Genomics England's software testing standards, processes, and best practices.

  • Design, build, maintain, and execute automated test frameworks using Python.

  • Contribute to quality engineering practices across the full SDLC, supporting both product-level and service-level assurance.

  • Work collaboratively with engineers to improve unit, integration, API, and end-to-end test coverage.

  • Help drive shift-left testing practices and ensure quality is built into products from the earliest stages of development.

  • Ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, test cases, defects, and evidence are traceable and auditable.

  • Support CI/CD implementation and test automation execution within deployment pipelines.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify risks, quality concerns, and opportunities to improve delivery confidence.

Everyday Responsibilities Include:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining Python-based automation frameworks and automated test suites.

  • Creating and executing automated UI, API, integration, and regression tests.

  • Reviewing requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure they are testable and complete.

  • Creating test cases and scenarios in Gherkin format using clear Given / When / Then structure.

  • Ensuring traceability between requirements, acceptance criteria, test cases, defects, test execution results, and test evidence.

  • Working closely with software engineers to improve automated coverage and support shift-left testing.

  • Executing automated and manual tests and recording results in Jira/Xray.

  • Investigating defects, supporting root cause analysis, and helping improve product quality.

  • Managing and preparing test data required for testing activities.

  • Supporting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated testing.

  • Producing and maintaining high-quality test documentation, test evidence, and quality reports.

  • Participating in sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement sessions, solution discussions, and peer reviews.

  • Working collaboratively with Product Managers, Engineers, QA colleagues, and SMEs to deliver high-quality outcomes.

  • Supporting non-functional testing activities where required, including performance and security validation

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Strong experience in Python test automation, including designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites.

  • Experience automating both UI and API testing using Python-based frameworks.

  • Good understanding of software testing principles, SDLC, Agile development practices, and quality engineering.

  • Experience in functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.

  • Experience reviewing requirements and acceptance criteria, creating test cases in Gherkin (Given/When/Then) format, and ensuring full traceability between requirements, acceptance criteria, test cases, defects, and test evidence.

  • Strong understanding of test design techniques, requirements analysis, test planning, test execution, and defect management.

  • Experience creating and maintaining test documentation, including test plans, test cases, test scripts, test reports, and test evidence.

  • Experience working in Agile squads and collaborating effectively with Product Managers, Software Engineers, SMEs, and QA colleagues.

  • Experience using Jira, Xray, Confluence, Git, and other software delivery and quality management tools.

  • Experience executing automated tests within CI/CD pipelines and maintaining automation execution processes.

  • Experience managing test data and validating data across multiple systems and databases.

  • Experience reporting, triaging, and tracking defects through to resolution.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to contribute to shift-left testing practices and work collaboratively to improve quality across the SDLC.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly articulate risks, issues, and quality recommendations.

  • ISTQB Foundation Certification (or equivalent software testing qualification).

Desirable Skills and Experience:

  • Experience working in a regulated environment such as Healthcare, NHS, Genomics, Medical Devices, Life Sciences, or other highly governed industries.

  • Experience with AWS cloud technologies, cloud-native applications, and testing distributed systems.

  • Experience with modern UI automation tools such as Playwright or Cypress.

  • Experience implementing contract testing using tools such as PACT.

  • Experience creating and maintaining mock APIs and services using tools such as WireMock.

  • Experience using Jira Xray and other test management and reporting tools.

  • Experience with security testing and vulnerability scanning tools such as OWASP ZAP, or similar, including knowledge of secure software testing practices.

  • Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards (e.g. FHIR), non-functional testing, performance testing, CI/CD practices, and test automation framework design

Qualifications

No specific qualifications are required. Relevant QA or software testing certifications are desirable but not essential. What matters most is demonstrable commercial experience as a QA Engineer, along with strong hands-on Python skills.

Additional Information

Salary From: £53,700

Closing Date: Thursday 6th August @ 23:00 (UK time)

Being an integral part of such a meaningful mission is extremely rewarding in itself, but in order to support our people, we’re continually improving our benefits package. We pride ourselves on investing in our people and supporting them to achieve their career goals, as well as offering a benefits package including:

  • Generous Leave: 30 days’ holiday, plus bank holidays, plus additional leave for long service, and also the option to apply for up to 30 days of remote working abroad annually (approval required).
  • Family-Friendly: Blended working arrangements, flexible working, enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave benefits.
  • Pension & Financial: Defined contribution pension (Genomics England double-matches up to 10%, however you can contribute more if you wish), Life Assurance (3x salary), an Electric Vehicle salary sacrifice scheme and a Give As You Earn scheme.
  • Learning & Development: Individual learning budgets, support for training and certifications, and reimbursement for one annual professional subscription (approval required).
  • Recognition & Rewards: Employee recognition programme and referral scheme.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Subsidised gym membership, a free Headspace account, and access to an Employee Assistance Programme, eye tests, flu jabs.

Equal opportunities and our commitment to a diverse and inclusive workplace

Genomics England is actively committed to providing and supporting an inclusive environment that promotes equity, diversity and inclusion best practice both within our community and in any other area where we have influence. We are proud of our diverse community where everyone can come to work and feel welcomed and treated with respect regardless of any disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, or social background.

Genomics England’s policies of non-discrimination and equity and will be applied fairly to all people, regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, being pregnant or recently becoming a parent, race, religion or beliefs, sex or sexual orientation, length of service, whether full or part-time or employed under a permanent or a fixed-term contract or any other relevant factor.

Genomics England does not tolerate any form of discrimination, harassment, victimisation or bullying at work. Such behaviour undermines our mission and core values and diminishes the dignity, respect and integrity of all parties. Our People policies outline our commitment to inclusivity.

We aim to remove barriers in our recruitment processes and to be flexible with our interview processes. Should you require any adjustments that may help you to fully participate in the recruitment process, we encourage you to discuss this with us.

Culture

We have four key behaviours that represent what we would like Genomics England to feel like and the culture we want to encourage, in order for us to achieve our mission. These behaviours help us all work well together, deliver on our outcomes, celebrate our successes and share feedback with each other. You can read about these and other aspects of our culture here Culture | Genomics England

Blended working model

Genomics England operates a blended working model as we know our people appreciate the flexibility that hybrid working can bring. We expect most people to come into the office a minimum of 2 times each month. However, this will vary according to role and will be agreed with your team leader. There is no expectation that people will return to the office full time unless they want to, however, some of our roles require full time on site attendance e.g., lab teams, reception team.

Our teams and squads have, and will continue to reflect on what works best for them to work together successfully and have the freedom to design working patterns to suit, beyond the minimum. Our office locations are: Canary Wharf, Cambridge and Leeds.

Onboarding background checks

As part of our recruitment process, all successful candidates are subject to a Standard Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. We therefore require applicants to disclose any previous offences at point of application, as some unspent convictions may mean we are unable to proceed with your application due to the nature of our work in healthcare.

title: Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring
description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring

The Opportunity:

The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.

Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.

The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.

The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.

What you'll be doing:

As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:

  • Own features end-to-end across the stack: from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React
  • Design and evolve systems, not just features: contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales
  • Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform
  • Make the product operable at enterprise scale: the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence
  • Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables and iterate quickly based on feedback
  • Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation: our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature
  • Be a part of the team's on-call rotation and take ownership of the services you're running

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Technologies you'll work with:

  • Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)
  • TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)
  • Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure
  • k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)
  • Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first company; communication is key.
  • For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.
  • Strong Go, or a path to it. We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.
  • Operational mindset. You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.
  • You are a systems thinker: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.
  • Pragmatism and short feedback loops. You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.
  • You have a good understanding of a software development process that takes a user-centered approach. You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.
  • You use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing or operating multi-tenant SaaS systems at scale
  • Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.)
  • Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment
  • Familiarity with k6, Playwright, or browser automation at scale
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open source projects

Compensation & Rewards:

In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 610,000 - SEK 762,500. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
