title: Loan Servicer
description:
Position Title: Loan Servicer

Department: Loan Operations

Classification: Non-Exempt

Revised: May 2026

Scope:

Under the direction of the Manager of Loan Operations, the Loan Servicer assists internal and external customers and assembles proper loan documentation for loan files.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  1. Loan Servicer Responsibilities:

    1. Booking & funding new loans

    1. Reviewing new loans & secondary market loans for proper approval, system accuracy and documentation requirements.

    1. Maintains financial institution loan records by reviewing various daily loan reports, which include but are not limited to the following: Tickler, New Loans, File Maintenance, Interest Fluctuation, Non-Activated Loans, etc.

    1. Maintains financial institution participation loan records by booking new participation loans, communicating with various participating banks, monthly payment posting and various maintenance and review of participation loans.

    1. Booking participation loans, monthly remittance of payments, daily payoff processing, etc for FreddieMac loans.

    1. Handles maintenance of loan portfolios for the financial institution including modifications, collateral changes, interest rate adjustments, loan reversals/corrections, auto pay - new and changes, monitoring construction loan disbursement and escrow setup, payout, and analysis.

    1. Reviewing insurance policies (real estate & other collateral). Updating the Core system for tracking & escrow. Reviewing reports for insurance coverage and processing mortgage escrow payouts through third-party Vendor – Allied Insurance & Accumatch Tax Service and various life insurance companies. Assist with the Annual Escrow Analysis and troubleshooting escrow issues. Refunding escrow on payoffs.

    1. Answers telephone and assist customers & third-party agents with routine inquiries regarding payoffs, changes of owner, name changes, and other loan details.

    1. Construction loan monitoring and draw processing to ensure projects are properly funded to stay within budget & completion. Use of 3rd party vendor processing system.

    1. Processing of paid off loans by releasing any mortgages/requesting UCC’s be terminated and send loan documents back to the Borrower.

    1. Processing of ACH payments requested by Borrowers or the Asset Mgmt. department.

    1. Maintains all collateral files for the institution. This includes organizing & tracking original mortgages and title vehicles for reports.

    1. Processing returned mail to obtain the correct address, address updates to the core and customer verification of those changes.

    1. Scans & prepare indexing for new loan files into Director. Update existing imaged files so most recent activity, maintenance, etc. can be found in Director. Add & clear exceptions as needed. Prepares the weekly report and final monthly Loan Exception Report for Mortgage/Consumer/Commercial loans. Scans & Reviews withdrawn & denied loan files for all loans

  1. Operations:
    1. Keep abreast of changes in products, policies, and procedures, and attend training as needed.
    2. Performs other duties as assigned.

  1. Customer Service:
    1. Assist customers with resolution of account problems and issues.
    2. Provides customer information and support.

Competencies:

  1. Managing Time:

Able set goals for oneself and to be a self-starter. Displays the ability to meet and set workflow deadlines.

  1. Oral/Written communication skills:

Must be able to communicate thoughts clearly, both orally and written.

  1. Customer Service:

Must understand customer needs and the elements of customer service. Must be able to refer customers to appropriate individuals for further assistance.

  1. Change management:

Must embrace change. Must see change as an opportunity. Must be willing to express and support manager’s ideas to affected staff.

  1. Knowledge of regulations that pertain to loan activities.

  1. Computer Knowledge:

Must have basic ability to operate computers, and software, such as Microsoft Word and Excel programs.

Special requirements for the position, in addition to the competencies and accountabilities listed above.

- Prefer a high school degree and 1 year experience in a related position in a financial institution.

- Must have the capacity to work under stress and handle difficult situations.

- Must be able to prepare basic documents in both Word & Excel.

- Must have the ability to be in tune with fine details & take initiative to research areas of possible concern.

JOB SUMMARY

This Operating Company (OpCo) based position will assist with the implementation of prevention-focused health, safety and environmental (HSE) and security program. The position will assist and promote OpCo- specific project implementation and training to support Sysco's overall HSE objectives, including security and crisis preparedness objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Complete new hire orientation training programs as assigned by the Safety Director.
  • Maintain records for safety programs (ie training logs, reports, inspections).
  • Implement and train new or existing training programs, provided by Safety Director, to employees and supervision as needed.
  • Inspect facilities to detect existing or potentially unsafe conditions
  • Participates in investigations, when needed, on vehicle accidents and injuries.
  • Assist with the identification of root causes and helps supervision develop corrective actions when needed.
  • Engages associates to properly follow work methods in their daily job functions.
  • Completes observations and coaching of high-risk associates as needed
  • Monitors inspection of equipment to detect existing or potential failures and recommends corrective/preventative measures where indicated.
  • Support site management in the implementation of health, safety, and environmental (HSE) plans.
  • Promotes a workplace that is a proactive safety culture.
  • Provide supervisor and management training on root cause analysis.
  • Interface with regulatory bodies (OSHA, DOT, EPA, and State/Local Regulators) in the Safety Directors absence.
  • Aids with the completion of a company-wide annual HSE training plan.
  • Develop effective interdepartmental relationships
  • Display strong problem solving, organizational and analytical skills.
  • Demonstrate professional maturity and ability to act as a change member.
  • Promote zero-incident HSE culture throughout the company.
  • Support execution of Sysco's Emergency Preparedness Plan procedures and policies.
  • Interprets trains and consistently enforces Company policies and procedures.
  • Maintains associate relations through regular interactions and communication, monitors associate morale and provides feedback to leadership when needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Associate's degree and/or a minimum of 2 years of safety experience with OSHA certifications.

Experience

  • 2+ years with direct hands-on safety experience in a warehousing, manufacturing or transportation operation.
  • 2+ years of experience with Occupational Safety preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations

  • Has attained or is working toward certification in safety as a recognized safety professional
  • Must possess a valid Driver's License

Professional Skills

  • Strong interest in safety with a proven record of results.
  • The ability to drive a strong safety philosophy and implement constructive behavior changes in Operations safety.
  • Solid analytical skills.

title: Intel Focused Video Analyst
description:
Full Motion Video (FMV) Analyst

Ideal for Intelligence Professionals Ready to Expand Their Tradecraft

Geo Owl is seeking motivated individuals with a background in Intelligence collection and analysis who are ready to transition into the world of Full Motion Video (FMV) intelligence. If you've worked at the tactical or operational level gathering and interpreting human intelligence, this position offers a powerful opportunity to expand your analytical impact in support of global counterterrorism operations.

Our FMV Analyst roles offer hands-on training across multiple intelligence disciplines, advanced tradecraft certification, and rapid pathways to career growth—including positions as instructors, subject matter experts, and managers. For INTELLIGENCE professionals and existing MOS-qualified FMV analysts, this role provides enhanced training beyond previous coursework, with your INTELLIGENCE expertise directly applied to multi-INT analysis and ISR exploitation.

We support missions that safeguard national security, protect our communities, and uphold the values that matter most. If you’ve contributed to the mission through HUMINT and want to grow into a broader multi-INT environment, this role is a natural next step.

What You’ll Do

  • Complete a three-week FMV tradecraft course followed by hands-on OJT
  • Apply Intelligence insights to enrich FMV exploitation and create intelligence products
  • Produce imagery graphics and reports for high-level government clients
  • Fuse HUMINT and SIGINT with ISR-collected FMV for actionable insights
  • Exploit NTM imagery using softcopy tools and light tables
  • Access certifications, generous PTO, and advancement opportunities from day one
  • Pursue cross-training in SAR, GMTI, FMV Advanced Research, and instructor roles

Who You Are

  • Able to work rotating shifts (7am–7pm or 7pm–7am) including weekends/holidays
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment
  • Clear communicator with TCPED experience
  • Eager to learn and grow in analytic and technical disciplines
  • Mission-driven problem solver with a government background
  • Active TS/SCI clearance holder and able to pass a polygraph

Required Education & Experience

  • 2+ years of intelligence experience OR Bachelor’s/Master’s in approved field
  • Completion of formal Intelligence course (e.g. HUMINT, SIGINT, IMINT, etc.)
  • Typing speed of 32 WPM with 90% accuracy
  • Understanding of the intelligence cycle/process
  • Must distinguish red, green, blue, and yellow on-screen
  • TS/SCI clearance and polygraph required


Benefits:

​

Health Insurance (Geo Owl pays 80%+ of the premium).

401k matching.

Dental, Vision, and other supplemental insurance plans available.

Company-paid short-term and long-term disability and life insurance.

Peer-to-Peer spot bonuses.

120 hours of PTO per year plus federal holidays.

Fully Paid Military Leave: *You make your full Geo Owl salary while you are on military duty*

Exiting the Military? Apply to our Military Transition Program for key insights into making the transition to civilian life from people who have been there before!

Engage with Your Team!

​

About Us:

Our mission is to empower EVERYONE with geospatial technologies.

Geo Owl is a premier provider of geospatial intelligence services, delivering cutting-edge solutions to the Department of Defense, intelligence agencies, and enterprises around the globe. Our comprehensive products and services include advanced geospatial analysis, imagery intelligence, remote sensing analysis, data science, and space-based custom intelligence solutions. At Geo Owl, we are dedicated to leveraging the latest analytic principles and technology to support and enhance the missions of our clients.

Our core values—innovation, integrity, and excellence—drive everything we do. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of geospatial intelligence to ensure our clients receive the most accurate, timely, and actionable intelligence possible. Integrity is at the heart of our operations; we uphold the highest standards of ethics and accountability in our work. Striving for excellence is not just a goal but a standard; we consistently aim to exceed expectations in every project.

Geo Owl's culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and respect. We cultivate an environment where team members can grow both personally and professionally. Our team is composed of passionate, dedicated experts who are always ready to support each other. We value work-life balance, offering flexible working arrangements and a supportive workplace where everyone feels valued.

At Geo Owl, we invest in our employees' growth and development. We provide ongoing training, career advancement opportunities, and a platform to work on impactful projects that make a real difference. Our team enjoys a strong sense of camaraderie and purpose, knowing that their work contributes to national security and global stability. If you are looking for a dynamic, rewarding career in geospatial intelligence, Geo Owl is the place for you. Join us and be part of a team that is shaping the future of geospatial intelligence.

description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Job Title: Field Service Representative E (FSR) Job Code: 41865 Job Location: Hurlburt Field, TX / Eglin AFB (Onsite) Schedule: 5/8; Rotating Shifts - Mission Dependent

J ob Description:

The Field Service Representative performs a variety of duties to provide technical support to the customer at a forward operating location.

E ssential Functions:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge and skill in the repair, maintenance, and Air Tractor mission systems and electronic equipment.
  • Maintains, repairs, tests and/or calibrates various types of aircraft electronic equipment.
  • Applies technical knowledge of electronic principles and strong knowledge in troubleshooting techniques to determine mission equipment malfunctions and restore aircraft mission systems to full operational status.
  • Performs work in accordance with technical manuals, schematics, engineering drawings, and written/verbal instructions.
  • Ability to meet worldwide immunization and deployment requirements and is eligible for access to required classified material.
  • Willingness and ability to work shifts as assigned and travel as part of a maintenance recovery team if required. CONUS and OCONUS deployment is required.
  • Capable of completing/passing a required physical exam and CRC course prior to OCONUS deployment.
  • Ability to work in the established OCONUS work/living environment, work shift schedules as assigned 7 days a week, 12 hours a day to support mission requirements.
  • Performs other assigned duties as required by Management.

Qualifications:

  • Requires a High School Diploma or equivalent and a minimum of 10 years of prior relevant experience or 2 years post-Secondary/Associates Degree in Electronic Technology, Computer Science, or Electronic Engineering with a minimum of 6 years of prior related experience.Minimum 6 years experience in satellite system architectures, time division multiple access protocols, UHF radio frequency transponder and antenna theory.
  • Minimum 6 years experience in UHF SATCOM system modulation/demodulation techniques, preamplifier, bandpass filter, and diplexer technology. Communications Security (COMSEC) and Transmission Security (TRANSEC) methods and procedures.
  • Minimum 6 years experience in Computer architectures; computer bus standards including VME, ISA, and PCI; serial and parallel computer interface standards including RS232, RS422, SCSI, IDE, PCMCIA, and IEEE802.3; Wide Area Network (WAN) interface standards and protocols.
  • Minimum 6 years experience in Software configuration and administration techniques to include Windows 7, Windows server, and Cisco. Extensive knowledge of IBS specific GOTS application including TipoffNT, MarsNT, and GTIW.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen.

Preferred Additional Skills:

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Knowledge of the Big Safari cradle-to- grave systems support and supply chain management processes is desired.
  • Knowledge of the DIA/DOD rules and regulations for systems security and hardening concepts such as DCID 6/3 is desired.
  • Strongly prefer experience in directly related operations and maintenance of ISR systems operations and maintenance, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Possesses strong communication skills to enable liaison with maintenance and operations personnel at all levels and train inexperienced combat systems technicians.
  • Strong communication skills to enable liaison with maintenance and operations personnel at all levels and train inexperienced combat systems technicians.

Work Environment:

The diversity of working conditions both CONUS and OCONUS range from an environment where there is little or no physical discomfort, to an environment where inclement weather may subject the individual to severe changes in temperature, wind, rain, etc. May be required to work in areas where high noise hazards, exposure to fumes, airborne particles, and electrical shock hazards exist.

description:

40 hr nights,

Provides a safe and secure environment for hospital patients, visitors, and employees by enforcing hospital security regulations and by continuously watching for and reporting potential safety hazards and unusual occurrences in a timely manner through patrol of assigned areas.

Investigate complaints or potential criminal conduct; assist in restraining patients as necessary; provide protective services.

title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer - Autosys Engineering
description:

title: Kommunikationskonsulent hos Lærernes a-kasse
description:
Kommunikationskonsulent hos Lærernes a-kasse






























































































































Erfaren kommunikationskonsulent til at drive vores medlemshvervning (barselsvikar)

I Lærernes a-kasse arbejder vi for lærere, undervisere, studerende og vejledere. Vi har en klar hvervningsstrategi og en stærk faglig position. Nu søger vi en kommunikationskonsulent til et barselsvikariat på minimum et år, der kan tage ejerskab over eksekveringen af vores hvervningsstrategi og være med til at sikre, at vi når flere af de medlemmer, vi er sat i verden for.

Du bliver en del af vores kommunikationsteam og får ansvaret for at udvikle, planlægge og gennemføre vores hvervningsindsatser. Online markedsføring fylder meget, og du kommer til at stå i front for samarbejdet med vores bureau, både i den daglige sparring og når strategierne skal udfoldes. Du måler effekten af det, vi laver, og du bruger resultaterne til at justere kursen.

Dine opgaver: 

Udvikle, planlægge og implementere indsatser i vores hvervningsstrategi for betalende medlemmer herunder online markedsføring


Bidrage til fastholdelse af eksisterende medlemmer i LAKA



Stå for samarbejdet med vores online marketingbureau og sikre, at vi får mest muligt ud af det


Udvikle, planlægge og implementere understøttende indsatser/redskaber ift. hvervning. Fx telefonisk indmeldelse, indmeldelsesblanket, lønsikring mv.


Stå for markedsføringen af lønsikring i samarbejde med LB Forsikring


Bidrage til udvikling af nye medlemstilbud


Udvikle materiale til brug på kongresser og selv deltage


Bidrage med indhold til vores hjemmeside


Være med til at fordele opgaver til og sparre med vores studentermedhjælpere


Ad hoc kommunikationsopgaver


Vi leder efter:


Dig som har solid erfaring med online markedsføring og som både kan samarbejde med og udfordre et bureau


Dig der har styr på effektmåling og bruger data aktivt i dit arbejde, ikke kun til at rapportere


Dig der har erfaring med medlemshvervning, gerne fra en anden medlemsorganisation


Du er en stærk skribent og kan variere din kommunikation til forskellige målgrupper


Du arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og tager ejerskab


Du er en god kollega, der gerne deler ud af din viden også til vores studentermedhjælpere


Hvad du får ud af det
Du får et selvstændigt ansvarsområde med plads til at sætte dit eget aftryk. Du bliver en del af et lille kommunikationsteam, hvor du både kan tænke strategisk og være tæt på eksekveringen. Hos os er der kort fra idé til handling. Det betyder, at du får reel indflydelse og kan være med til at forme udviklingen. Vores kontor ligger på Kompagnistræde i Indre By.

Sammen med omkring 80 dygtige kollegaer arbejder vi i Lærernes a-kasse dagligt for medlemmerne og bidrager til et professionelt sikkerhedsnet for den ledige lærer, underviser og vejleder. Vi hjælper hinanden med at løse problemstillinger på tværs af teams. Hverdagen i Lærernes a-kasse bygger på faglighed, respekt og kollegial støtte. Vi ser hinandens styrker, hjælper hinanden og er nysgerrige på hinandens erfaringer. Vi har et godt arbejdsklima.

Du ansættes på attraktive ansættelsesvilkår med bl.a. arbejdsgiverbetalt pension på 18%. Arbejdstiden er 37 timer inkl. pauser. Du får reference til administrationschef Heidi Olsen.

Sådan søger du
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og lukker jobannoncen, når vi har fundet den rigtige kandidat. Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit cv via nedenstående link.

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på minimum et år og med start senest 1. oktober 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte administrationschef Heidi Olsen på 70 10 00 18 eller mail: hol@laka.dk. Heidi kan kontaktes fra den 3. august.

Lærernes a-kasse ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen. Vi behandler alle henvendelser fortroligt.

Lærernes a-kasse er en fagligt afgrænset a-kasse for alle undervisere. De nyuddannede, folkeskolelærerne, børnehaveklasselærerne, voksen- og ungdomsunderviserne, lærerne ved de frie grund- og efterskoler, AMU-centre, FGUer og institutioner for specialundervisning. Vi har ca. 74.000 medlemmer og kontorer i København, Odense, Esbjerg, Aarhus og Aalborg.

Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Business Analyst to help shape the strategic direction of new credit card acquisitions for Wells Fargo Branded Credit Card business. It is a Strategy/Growth role where the primary objective is building intent that drives profitable new account acquisitions. The Lead Business Analyst will play a pivotal role in defining, championing and executing strategies that enhance reach of our acquisition strategies.

At Wells Fargo, we're building the next generation of growth strategies for one of the nation's largest branded credit card portfolios. This is an opportunity to influence how millions of customers engage with our products while driving measurable business growth in a highly visible role.

As a Lead Business Analyst on the Credit Card Branch Acquisition team, you'll help shape credit card acquisition strategy for Wells Fargo Branches, across all customer segments. You'll partner with senior leaders and key stakeholders across Decision Sciences, Underwriting, Credit Risk, Finance & Legal to identify growth opportunities, optimize customer acquisition, and enhance portfolio profitability.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, leveraging data to drive decisions, and influencing strategy within a large-scale consumer lending organization. This role is also ideal for someone who enjoys challenging status quo.

  • Develop, drive, and influence comprehensive, decision-ready business cases with a strong focus on competitor approaches spanning multiple domains including marketing acquisition, product strategy, and credit risk, to enhance the customer value proposition and experience

title: Data Architect
description:
This isn't a role where you'll inherit someone else's roadmap and spend your time tweaking it around the edges - you'll be helping shape it.

This organisation is investing heavily in its data capability, and they're looking for someone who can bring structure to complexity, create a long-term architectural vision and help turn data into a genuine business asset.

You'll be the person connecting Technology, Data and Transformation teams, making sure everyone is pulling in the same direction - it's a role with genuine influence.

One day you might be mapping enterprise data flows and defining governance standards. The next you'll be working with engineering teams on cloud data platforms, representing the data function at architecture boards, or helping senior stakeholders understand how better information architecture can unlock better decisions.

There's plenty of variety, but the common theme is ownership of the new Data Platform. A Data Product Owner.

They're looking for someone who enjoys asking "Why are we doing it this way?" before designing something better.

You'll probably have experience with most of the following:
  • Enterprise data architecture
  • Data modelling and governance
  • Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP
  • SQL Server, Oracle or similar database technologies
  • Data integration tools
  • Modern data warehouse and analytics solutions
  • Working with both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with Microsoft Fabric would be very useful, but it certainly isn't a deal-breaker.

This isn't the kind of environment where architecture sits in a document gathering dust.

The work you do will shape how data is managed across the organisation for years to come. You'll have the backing to improve standards, introduce best practice, mentor others and genuinely influence the direction of travel.

It's a predominantly remote role, visiting the central London offcies twice a month to be withe the teams.

If you're someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges and wants a role where your opinion actually carries weight, we'd love to tell you more.

Apply now or get in touch for a confidential chat.

Psykolog til stilling som afdelingspsykolog på Behandlingsinstitutionen Egholt, 30-37 timer 



Har du interesse for udviklingspsykologi/udviklingstraumer, psykiatri og miljøterapi og har du gode formidlingsevner, så har vi jobbet til dig. 


Egholt ligger midt på Sjælland ved Sorø, og har eksisteret i 45 år. Vi har et børne- og ungehjem (10-18 år) samt to boenheder for unge voksne (16-30 år). Herudover har vi en projektafdeling for børn/unge der har behov for et specialiseret og skærmet tilbud. Vi har egen skole og STU samt dagtilbud. Vores beboere er kendetegnet ved normal begavelse, men med en høj grad af kompleksitet i deres psykiske problemstillinger, og vi er stolte af at kunne rumme denne kompleksitet. Vores praksis er miljøterapeutisk, og vores teoretiske grundlag er tilknytningsteoretisk, traumeinformeret, psykodynamisk samt mentaliseringsbaseret.


Vores ene afdelingspsykolog har fornyeligt valgt at søge nye veje, og derfor søger vi en ny afdelingspsykolog. Vi har i forvejen en chefpsykolog, som varetager mange forskellige opgaver, og som er behandlingsansvarlig på stedet, samt en afdelingspsykolog. Vi er en integreret del af organisationen, men værdsætter også et solidt psykologfælleskab.


Vi tilbyder varierede arbejdsopgaver, som bl.a. omfatter afholdelse af behandlingskonferencer og efterfølgende skrivning af behandlingsplaner, intern supervision af miljøterapeuter, individuel terapi med børn og/eller voksne og skriftlige opgaver som fx deltagelse i statusrapportskrivning. Alt efter din erfaring og evner er der mulighed for at undervise på vores interne uddannelse i samarbejde med Center for Miljøterapi. Vi søger blandt andet en ny psykologkollega, da vi har ambitioner om at kunne udvikle på flere opgaver som f.eks. forældrearbejde og psykologiske undersøgelser.


Vi tilbyder fleksibilitet i forhold til antal af ugentlige timer (30-37) og tilrettelæggelse af arbejdet, selvfølgelig inden for visse rammer. Vi har en skøn kantine, som også er en del af dagtilbuddet, som vi bliver meget forkælede af. Vi er en flok af engagerede og erfarne medarbejdere som brænder for vores sted og som også har en rar og meget tillidsfuld omgangsform. Psykologerne har til huse i en smuk gammel hovedbygning, hvor der også er busstop lige ude foran.


Der er mulighed for både intern og ekstern supervision, og har du ikke din (kliniske) praksisuddannelse, arbejder vi sammen på, at du kan få den.


Vi forventer at du er fagligt ambitiøs og har gode formidlingsevner i både skrift og tale. Din primære opgave er at understøtte miljøterapien, og derfor skal behandlingsplaner og andet materiale være let tilgængeligt for miljøterapeuterne. Vi forventer et teoretisk udgangspunkt, som matcher Egholts.


Vi forventer at du har erfaring med at rumme egne og andres følelser og kan forblive rolig i mødet med et intenst følelsesmæssigt pres. I samme ombæring forventer vi, at du kan række ud efter samt tage imod hjælp, når dette bliver nødvendigt.


Vi vil gerne have en psykolog med erfaring indenfor de beskrevne opgaver, men engagement, et godt læringspotentiale og nysgerrighed overfor vores komplekse målgruppe samt miljøterapien, vægter lige så højt.


Du er velkommen til at kontakte ledende psykolog Maja Maria Zwolinska for yderligere information om stillingen på tlf. 21803113. Send din ansøgning før den 10. august 2026 på ansoegning@egholt.dk. Skriv psykolog i emnefeltet. Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler snarest derefter. Vi er fleksible i forhold til tiltrædelsesdato.

title: Telehealth Registered Dietitian | FT W2
description:
Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by over 60,000 women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We’re hiring Registered Dietitians who want to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to women who have historically been underserved. To learn more about our mission and clinical approach, visit .

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

  • Analyze intake assessments, including medical history, dietary habits, laboratory results, and more.

  • Conduct diet and lifestyle counseling and education sessions via video, including offering general movement, sleep, or stress management advice as needed and related to nutrition care.

  • Employ Allara’s provided nutrition training and educational materials to ensure consistent care while adapting to patient needs.

  • Incorporate motivational interviewing and behavior change techniques throughout the continuity of care.

  • Collaborate with APRNs and MDs involved in the medical management of your patients.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records.

  • Responsibilities also include charting, addressing patient inquiries, and responding to administrative tasks and messages in a timely manner.

Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Registered Dietitian with current certification from the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

  • Experience: 1-year experience treating patients with complex women’s health conditions (strongly desired).

  • Clinical Independence: Proven ability to function as an autonomous provider with strong diagnostic judgment and critical thinking skills

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with an emphasis on compassion and clarity

  • Webside Manner: A natural ability to build trust and connection with patients in a virtual setting

  • Evidence-Based Practice: A genuine commitment to delivering care rooted in current clinical research

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working across multiple platforms including EMR systems, text expanders, Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, and scheduling tools

  • Telemedicine Experience: Prior telehealth experience is a plus

  • State License Requirements & Hiring Considerations: An active, unrestricted, and unencumbered professional license in at least one U.S. state is required.

A note on state licensing: All active and pending licenses held at the time of application are collected and reviewed during our process. Hiring decisions reflect current state-level needs, which evolve over time. Applicants may not move forward immediately if there is no active need in their licensed states. We regularly revisit candidates as needs expand and when experience, licensure, and role requirements align.

What Allara Offers

  • Annual base salary: $65,000 + the ability to increase up to $105,000 through our incentive compensation program

  • Health and Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Future Planning: 401(k) plan

  • Time Off: Annual vacation, sick days, and holidays

  • Annual CEU/WFH Stipend

  • Continuing Education: Access to multiple free, live CEU sessions every month, plus a Women's Health Certificate of Training launching in 2027!

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the U.S.

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set your schedule within full-time hour requirements

  • Malpractice Insurance: Comprehensive coverage provided at no cost to you

  • Mission-Driven Work: Help transform the standard of care for women living with conditions that have historically been underdiagnosed and undertreated

  • Collaborative Provider Network: Connect with and learn from a community of skilled, like-minded Allara clinicians

  • Inclusive Culture: Join a supportive, diverse team that values innovation, equity, and belonging

At Allara, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against candidates or patients based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Vi søger servicemedarbejdere til sommerafløsning i perioden juni, juli og august.

Afvaskning af gulve med gulvvaskemaskine og aftørring af inventar samt rengøring af toiletter, omklædning, kantine og baderum

Du har erfaring med rengøring og service og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

Du kan kommunikere mundtligt og skriftligt på dansk eller engelsk

Løn ifølge Serviceoverenskomsten.

Oplæring og mulighed for dansk kursus, AMU-kurser eller erhvervsuddannelse med løn

Mulighed for at leje attraktive ferieboliger i både ind- og udland (fx Lalandia).

title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

You will be responsible for turning research direction into working, production-grade ML systems. This role owns the execution layer of A1’s intelligence – training pipelines, inference systems, evaluation tooling, and deployment.

Focus

  • Build and own end-to-end ML pipelines spanning data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Fine-tune and adapt models using state-of-the-art methods such as LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, and distillation.

  • Architect and operate scalable inference systems, balancing latency, cost, and reliability.

  • Design and maintain data systems for high-quality synthetic and real-world training data.

  • Implement evaluation pipelines covering performance, robustness, safety, and bias, in partnership with research leadership.

  • Own production deployment, including GPU optimization, memory efficiency, latency reduction, and scaling policies.

  • Collaborate closely with application engineering to integrate ML systems cleanly into backend, mobile, and desktop products.

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs and ship improvements quickly, learning from real usage.

  • Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety

Requirements

  • Strong background in deep learning and transformer-based architectures.

  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying large-scale ML models in production.

  • Proficiency with at least one modern ML framework (e.g. PyTorch, JAX), and ability to learn others quickly.

  • Experience with distributed training and inference frameworks (e.g. DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron, ZeRO, Ray).

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals – you write robust, maintainable, production-grade systems.

  • Experience with GPU optimization, including memory efficiency, quantization, and mixed precision.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous, zero-to-one ML systems end-to-end.

  • A bias toward shipping, learning fast, and improving systems through iteration.

Ideal Experience

  • Experience with LLM inference frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or FasterTransformer.

  • Contributions to open-source ML or systems libraries.

  • Background in scientific computing, compilers, or GPU kernels.

  • Experience with RLHF pipelines (PPO, DPO, ORPO).

  • Experience training or deploying multimodal or diffusion models.

  • Experience with large-scale data processing (Apache Arrow, Spark, Ray).

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Work Where You Matter

At Dollar General, our mission is Serving Others! We value each and every one of our employees. Dollar General Corporation has been delivering value to shoppers for more than 80 years. Dollar General helps shoppers Save time. Save money. Every day.® by offering products that are frequently used and replenished, such as food, snacks, health and beauty aids, cleaning supplies, basic apparel, housewares and seasonal items at everyday low prices in convenient neighborhood locations. Learn more about Dollar General at www.dollargeneral.com/about-us.html.

A Senior Software Engineer will be responsible for building technologies across eCommerce & Loyalty experience for our customers. A Senior Software Engineer, working independently or with limited supervision, translates high-level business requirements into technical designs, proposes design alternatives, codes and/or communicates requirements to junior engineers. They have a strong knowledge of the applications in their functional area, how each supports the goals of the business and how they interface with each other and to applications outside of their area. They lead small development engagements, mentor junior engineers, solve difficult and highly complex technical problems and may be called on to consult on other projects.

Job Details

Duties & Responsibilities:
• Develops and debugs software in support of new and existing applications 65%
• Develop, execute and thoroughly document unit and system-level test plans 15%
• Designs changes to new and existing applications 10%
• Provides support for production applications (7x24) 5%
• Participate in Agile methodology and ceremonies 5%

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSAs):
• Develop and maintain Rest/gRCP Service for e-commerce and loyalty application with high-quality, scalable and performant code.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into API specifications.
• Monitor and analyze API performance metrics to identify areas for improvement.
• Writing and maintaining API Documentation for developers and consumers.
• Mentor junior team members and seek guidance from senior team members.
• Participates in code reviews and scope of work estimation and forecasting.
• Collaborate with frontend and backend developers to ensure seamless integration of APIs with the application.
• Writes high-quality code that meets the customer needs and strives for simplicity, clarity and testability.
• Able to provide application support, analyze problems and provide solutions for complex issues.
• Able to develop reusable software building blocks to enable faster delivery.
• Employs test-driven development and integrates unit tests in development tasks.
• Strong ability to relate code modules to the application as a whole and the underlying business objectives.
• Able to stay current on technology changes applicable to your domain and how to apply them.
• Strong analytical skills with experience gathering requirements and designing new functionality.

*Salary Range USD $115,905.00/Yr to USD $120,905.00/Yr.*

Qualifications

Work Experience &/or Education:
• 5+ years experience in software development in an IT organization or equivalent educational experience.
• 5+ years experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs using .Net Framework/Core and C#.
• 3+ years experience delivering software supporting e-commerce applications.
• 3+ years experience with a relational database (i.e., Oracle, MSSQL, Postgres, etc.).
• 1+ years of experience with No-SQL Databases (i.e Cassandra, Mongo DB etc)
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field, trade school or equivalent work experience.
• Experience deploying and managing applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
• Experience with containers and orchestration via Kubernetes or equivalent is a plus.
• Experience in implementing event driven systems using messaging platforms like RabbitMQ, Kafka or Azure Service Bus.

title: Head of HR - Brazil
description:
Head of HR - Brazil
Betim MG, Brazil
Hybrid


Purpose of Role:

As Head of HR Brazil, you will lead the people agenda across our Brazil business, partnering closely with business leaders to drive business performance, organizational effectiveness, transformation, and workforce agility. This is a strategic business partnering role requiring an enterprise mindset and the ability to balance immediate business priorities with long-term organizational goals. Sitting at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will simplify structures, accelerate decision-making, and shape people strategies aligned with business objectives. The role is pivotal in embedding the "One Weir" approach, enabling sustainable change, fostering operational excellence, and building a high-performing organization positioned for long-term success.

What we do at Weir

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

Make your impact

You’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our business through our people. Partnering with leaders across Brazil, you’ll drive transformation, strengthen organizational capability, and build a high-performing culture that enables business success. You’ll influence decisions that matter, lead with purpose, and create an environment where people and performance thrive. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day, and help shape a more sustainable future.

What you’ll do

  • Strategic Business Partnership: Partner with business leaders to understand current and future workforce needs, leveraging data and insights to inform strategic people decisions, anticipate challenges, and unlock opportunities that support business objectives.

  • Employee Engagement: Shape and execute Brazil's engagement strategy, using employee feedback and organizational insights to strengthen engagement, address opportunities, and build on areas of success.

  • Workforce Planning & Talent Strategy: Lead key people processes across Brazil, including talent reviews, succession planning (TDSP), performance management, engagement, and compensation activities, ensuring alignment with business priorities and an outstanding employee experience.

  • Employee & Labor Relations: Provide strategic leadership across employee and labor relations within a unionized workforce environment, including collective bargaining, contract interpretation, grievance resolution, labor negotiations, and complex employee relations matters.

  • Lead & Develop the HR Function: Build organizational capability by developing talent and creating a high-trust, high-performance HR team that delivers measurable business impact.

  • HR Leadership & Service Delivery: Lead the delivery of a high-quality HR experience across Brazil, partnering closely with leaders and employees to drive business performance, organizational effectiveness, and employee engagement.

  • Leadership & Culture:Champion and role model Weir's values, fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture that enables individuals and teams to thrive.

  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure compliance with employment legislation, company policies, and HR best practices, while partnering with HR Centres of Excellence (CoEs) and WBS teams to deliver consistent and effective people solutions.

  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI): Champion inclusive practices that create an environment where all employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to do the best work of their lives.

  • Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world class safety culture.


What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, ideally within complex, matrixed organizations.

  • A recognized HR qualification or equivalent professional experience with a proven track record of partnering with senior leaders as a trusted HR Business Partner.

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, with strong communication skills and the ability to build effective partnerships across the business.

  • Proven ability to translate business priorities into people strategies that enhance organizational performance and support business growth.

  • Strategic and forward-thinking mindset, with the ability to turn vision into actionable people plans and initiatives.

  • Strong expertise in Brazilian labor legislation and employee relations, ideally within complex or unionized environments.

  • Strong business and commercial acumen, with the confidence to influence, challenge, and advise leaders constructively.

  • Experience coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams and leaders.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience working across functions, cultures, and matrix environments.

  • Demonstrated success leading organizational change and transformation initiatives.

  • Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess organizational needs and drive effective change.

  • Ability to build credibility and influence decision-making while establishing trusted relationships at all levels of the organization.

  • Results-oriented and pragmatic, balancing strategic thinking with practical execution.

  • Global mindset and cultural agility, with the ability to operate effectively across diverse business environments.

  • Data-driven and technology-enabled, leveraging people analytics, insights, and HR systems to support strategic decision-making.

  • Experience with Workday and ServiceNow is preferred.

Why join Weir?

We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay.

  • Career development and learning support.

  • Access to global inclusion networks.

  • Regional and team-specific benefits.

  • Sharebuilder scheme.

  • Wellness support for you and your family.

  • Collaboration with global teams.

  • Study support.

For additional information about what it is like to work at Weir, please visit our Career Page and LinkedIn Life Page.

Weir is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

title: Production Assembler
description:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Starting Wage: $19.50 /hourly

IEM Canada, (Industrial Electric Manufacturing, Inc.) in Surrey, BC, is the largest independent full-line manufacturer of custom electrical distribution and power quality equipment in North America. IEM has delivered customer-specific solutions to meet the ever-changing power requirements of growth industries in North America for over half a century.

The Production Assembler position will receive training in both mechanical and electrical assembly processes. Working as part of a manufacturing team, the Production Assembler learns to assemble mechanical frames, electrical distribution equipment, and related components while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity. This role follows established work instructions, supports daily production schedules, maintains an organized work area, and contributes to a safe, collaborative, and continuous learning work environment.

What you will be responsible for:
  • Assemble mechanical frames, components, and electrical equipment according to engineering drawings, work instructions, and manufacturing specifications.
  • Safely operate hand and power tools, including screwdrivers, impact drivers, drills, tape measures, machinist squares, T-squares, and other assembly equipment.
  • Meet daily production schedules and productivity goals while maintaining quality standards.
  • Inspect completed work throughout the assembly process to ensure products are free from defects.
  • Perform metal corrections and touch-up painting as directed.
  • Follow standard work procedures and manufacturing guidelines.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area by following 5S principles and housekeeping standards.
  • Monitor and track performance against key metrics (output, defects, rework, attendance, downtime) and lead Tier 2 daily management meetings.
  • Coordinate with Planning, Materials, Quality, and Maintenance to ensure work center readiness (materials, tools, documents, etc.).
  • Comply with all company safety policies, quality standards, work rules, and operating procedures.
  • Communicate production progress, concerns, and improvement opportunities to the supervisor.
  • Assist with inventory organization, material handling, and workstation preparation as needed.
  • Support cross-training and learn additional assembly processes to increase production flexibility.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce waste.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Mechanical aptitude with experience using basic hand and power tools preferred.
  • Ability to read and follow work instructions and manufacturing documentation.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining accuracy and quality.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
  • Demonstrated commitment to workplace safety.
  • Strong work ethic, willingness to learn, and positive attitude.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Interpret, analyze, research and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Reliable transportation required.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday. (95%)
  • Frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to bend, squat, kneel, reach, and perform repetitive assembly tasks.
  • Manual dexterity to safely operate hand and power tools.
  • Vision: Long periods of close work on small fonts and fine print on drawings and ability to see small or detailed items
  • Ability to climb ladders as required.
Work Environment
  • Manufacturing and warehouse environment.
  • Facility is not climate controlled and may involve exposure to heat, cold, humidity, dust, fumes, noise, vibration, and other industrial conditions.
  • Required use of appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) and compliance with all company safety policies and procedures.

title: Director of Product Management - Content
description:
Director of Product Management

Candidates must already live in the United States, #LI-Remote

At Lexipol, our mission is to create safer communities and empower the individuals on the front lines with market-leading content and technology. Our top-notch team works closely with law enforcement, fire, EMS, corrections, and local government professionals to tailor our solutions to better address today’s challenges and keep first responders coming home safely at the end of each shift.

Working at Lexipol means making a difference – day in and day out.

The Work
The Solutions Management team leads the organization in product strategy. The product management team is responsible for overseeing the development and success of the company’s products. We function as the fulcrum balancing customer needs with Lexipol’s growth objectives.

We are actively hiring a Director of Product Management to lead the development and lifecycle management of our learning products. The ideal candidate will have a proven SaaS Product Management track record of owning the business strategy, delivering market-leading products, possess strong analytical skills, and excel at driving cross-functional teams towards a common goal. As a Director of Product Management, you will collaborate closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales, and customer success teams to drive product innovation, market expansion, revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and overall business success.

This is done through working in these areas of focus:

Product Strategy & Innovation
  • Develop and communicate a clear and compelling product strategy that aligns with company goals, market trends, and customer needs.
  • Conduct customer and competitive research as part of gathering Voice of the customer information
  • Host internal strategy and market intelligence sessions
  • Deliver MRDs and PRDs for product initiatives
  • Make pricing recommendations to meet revenue and profitability goals
  • Innovation: Continuously innovate and iterate on products, identifying opportunities for enhancements and features that drive competitive advantage.

Product Development
  • Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from concept to launch, ensuring high-quality products are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Requirements Definition: Define clear and detailed product requirements, user stories, and use cases that guide the development team and ensure a shared understanding of the product vision.
  • Metrics and Analysis: Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and use data-driven insights to measure the success of products and identify areas for optimization.
  • Innovation: Continuously innovate and iterate on products, identifying opportunities for enhancements and features that drive competitive advantage.


Product Road Map
  • Roadmap Planning: Create and manage the product roadmap, defining prioritization of features, enhancements, and new products based on business value and customer impact.
  • Market Analysis: Conduct thorough market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to identify new opportunities, trends, and areas for differentiation.
  • Test and refine the roadmap.
  • Identify new areas of organic growth.
  • Generate market and product requirements and build business case for new ideas.

Execution
  • Create user personas, user stories, use cases, flowcharts, basic conceptual wireframes, and other documentation as needed to drive forward the software development process.
  • Work with sales, product & corporate marketing, and customer success leaders to implement the go-to-market plans and create action plans to meet top line revenue targets.
  • Develop a KPI dashboard to report on and improve product performance .
  • Collaborate with program manager and work cross-functionally to execute product development initiatives in a timely manner.

Cross Functional Leadership:
  • Lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer support, to ensure alignment and successful execution of the product strategy.
  • Collaborate with engineering to guide product development and prioritization, and run alpha, beta, and pilot programs with early-stage products.
  • Guide the sales team and the customer success team in their efforts in sales, renewals, and upgrades and collaborate with product marketing to improve the customer journey
  • Collaborate with the product management leadership team to champion our products.
  • Assist the product management leadership team with reporting and presentations.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Effectively communicate product updates, progress, and roadmaps to internal stakeholders, external partners, and customers.

M&A support:
  • Support M&A transactions

Requirements: To be considered for this role, you will have this experience:
  • Minimum of 7 to 10 years of recent SaaS Product Management experience
  • Demonstrated success defining and launching excellent B2B and/or B2G SaaS products
  • Executive level written and verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Management Consulting experience is a definite plus
  • Experiencing leveraging AI within technology products
  • High comfort level utilizing AI tools
  • High intellectual and execution horsepower
  • MBA preferred
  • Proven experience in creating product requirements & user stories that provide clear and detailed guidelines for the development team
  • Strong understanding of product development methodologies, including Agile and Scrum.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence without direct authority.
  • Analytical mindset with proficiency in using data-driven insights to inform product decisions.
  • Strong leadership and team management abilities, with experience leading cross-functional teams.
  • Strong skills with product management tools and software.
  • Excellent teamwork skills

Preferred Experience:
  • Experience in a role in the public safety market. Knowledge of public safety and emerging trends is highly desirable.
  • Certification and experience in agile software development: Agile Scrum Product Owner, Scaled Agile, PMI-ACP
  • Pragmatic Marketing Certified

Target Outcomes/ Target Results
  • Ensure revenue and customer satisfaction goals are met.
  • Meet YOY growth targets.
  • Maintain or improve NPS scores and KPIs.
  • Manage priorities to maximize product and customer outcomes.
  • Become a highly functioning teammate that encourages success throughout the organization and mentors and accepts feedback from others.

Employee Value Proposition
  • The product team is a high-performance team focused on supporting public safety organizations with high quality content delivered through technology to enable organizational success. What you do here matters.
  • This is a role with high visibility across the organization including C-Suite presentation and communication.
  • You will have the opportunity to hone your influence and collaboration skills across the company.
  • This role requires taking ownership and leading the organization for product success and you’ll have the opportunity to expand your leadership capacity.
  • This role reports to the VP of Solution Management, who will be your champion and offer mentorship to elevate your skills.

The Environment
  • Full time remote position with schedule flexibility requiring availability during core hours across US time zones.
  • Lexipol strives to provide a professional, ethical, and collaborative environment and is a largely remote workforce. Videoconference use is standard in meetings.
  • Join a dedicated and growing product team and be a key part in building the future of Lexipol’s offering.
  • The workload and commitment of our team is best suited to individuals who can parse out their priorities and enjoy overcoming the challenges along the way.
  • Make a difference in the public safety profession through delivering superior offerings that elevate our customers’ performance to the public.

Duties listed are not intended to be exhaustive or exclusive; other duties may be assigned. Management retains the discretion to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits
Lexipol offers a competitive base salary, monthly or annual incentive and a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k) with Company match and a flexible paid time off plan.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer (Agentic Workflows)
description:
About Us
Life Science Connect is transforming from a traditional B2B publisher into a modern data authority. We build the specialized platforms, identity systems, and intelligence layers that help life sciences professionals accelerate development and discover market opportunities. We are leaning heavily into a high-efficiency, decoupled stack and modern, AI-augmented engineering workflows to build products that matter.

The Mission
We are looking for a hands-on, high-velocity Full-Stack Engineer to join our core product engineering team. You will not be moving tickets across a board all day or sitting in endless alignment meetings. You will be building, iterating, and shipping.
This role is focused on expanding our digital footprint: rapidly developing our internal company intelligence platform, deploying customer-facing tools, optimizing headless Optimizely integrations, and expand our architecture to new product lines. You will work directly with our Principal Software Engineer to turn product initiatives into high-utility, revenue-generating reality.

What You’ll Actually Do
  • Build with Leverage: Own the implementation of new product features and decoupled architecture using Next.js and React maintaining a relentless focus on performance and minimal technical debt.
  • Orchestrate Agentic Workflows: Integrate Cursor and agentic engineering methodologies into your daily development loop. We don't just tolerate AI-assisted coding; we expect you to master context window management, multi-file prompting, and local execution blocks to achieve a massive output multiplier.
  • Integrate Headless Infrastructure: Develop clean, reusable front-end components that hook seamlessly into a Headless CMS (Optimizely/ODP), ensuring our content delivery is lightning-fast at the edge.
  • Collaborate across the Core: Partner directly with our Data and DevOps teams to ensure everything we ship maintains data integrity across our Snowflake core, supports progressive profiling, and moves through our automated CI/CD pipeline cleanly.

What We Are Looking For
  • 3+ Years of Experience: You’ve spent significant time in production codebases building modern, full-stack web applications.
  • The Modern Stack: Deep familiarity with Next.js, React, RESTful APIs, and cloud deployments (Vercel/GitHub Actions).
  • Augmented Engineering Native: You have spent the last year moving past basic code completion and into deep, hands-on usage of Cursor and agentic software tools. You know how to guide an LLM to build exactly what you need without letting it create a mountain of spaghetti code.
  • Product Mentality: You care about the "why" behind the code. You understand how an elegant interface or integration translates to user retention, direct data-sharing utility, and business revenue. We see personalization and augmenting our processes with intelligence is the key to success.
  • Autonomy: You are comfortable working in a distributed environment where documentation matters, specifications drive development, and independent problem-solving is prized above micromanagement.

We Invest in YOU
At Life Science Connect, our commitment to empowering innovation and facilitating growth within the life sciences sector extends to our employees. We offer a comprehensive total compensation program designed to support your overall health, financial well-being, and professional development.
In addition to a competitive salary, you'll enjoy:
● Medical/vision/prescription/dental coverage for you and your family
● 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability insurance
● 100% company-paid life insurance
● 401(k) with dollar-for-dollar company match up to 6%
● 15 vacation days and 6 personal days on day 1
● 13 company-paid holidays

Job Description:

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Cost Estimator to join our team supporting our federal client in the delivery of high visibility infrastructural projects central to a federal government Design-Build programs. In this role you will provide cost estimating expertise to support the client’s expanding nationwide construction program.

High preference is to get a candidate located in the Huntsville , AL area however if not the positions can be Remote with 50% travel.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Analyze designs, drawings, proposals, scopes of work, and/or specifications to determine cost projections, and develop comprehension budget cost estimates for complex buildings, MEP systems and infrastructure for a variety of facility types
  • Assist in the development and preparation of detailed work breakdown structures (WBS) and construction logic for contracts, projects and elements of programs to support the development of estimate development and delivery.
  • Prepare and summarize tasked estimates, including labor and material rates, equipment rates, productivity rates, efficiencies, and other resources and impacts that determine unit cost to be utilized for specific scope of work.

  • Utilize training in the prescribed estimating software and estimating tools necessary to perform quantity takeoffs, estimate calculations, bid item detail development, resource reports, and work activity definition.

  • Develops basis of the estimate (BOE) narrative that clearly defines estimate methodology, scope, pricing characteristics, escalation, assumptions, and exclusions such that the customer has complete understanding of the content and the components of the delivered estimate of probable cost.
  • Ensures that all estimate team members apply company estimating practices, techniques, processes, and procedures. Responsible for providing technical guidance and training to Estimators and Associate Estimators.

  • Must have a current/active Secret clearance or above
  • Reviewing designs and developing cost estimates for Federal facilities and related infrastructure including, but not limited to barracks, classroom/training facilities, marine docks, ship repair dry dock facilities, administrative buildings, Data Centers

  • Experience using typical cost estimation software/resources such as RS Means, Timberline, CostWorks, Success Estimator, MCACES, PACES, Revu Bluebeam

title: Senior Product Design Manager
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the role

Fivetran + dbt Labs is hiring a Senior Manager to lead the Product Design team responsible for dbt Labs. This role reports to the Director of Product Design.

This is an exciting time to join! As Fivetran and dbt Labs come together, you will help shape a coherent product experience, guide the design team through change, and influence the future of AI-powered data products. You will join a strong and talented design organization whose members care deeply about their craft, the practitioners they serve, and one another.

This is a people management and product leadership role for a design leader who wants to shape technical data products at scale. You will manage and develop a team of product designers, shape the UX strategy for dbt products, and partner with Product and Engineering leaders to define how data teams build, transform, govern, and trust their data. You will lead through strategy, coaching, direction, and cross-functional partnership.

What you'll do

Lead the dbt product design team

You will manage and coach a team of product designers who work across dbt platform and CLI-based products. Designers own the full design process from problem definition and research to UX/UI and partnering with eng/PM through delivery. You will build a culture where designers feel supported, challenged, and empowered to do thoughtful, high-quality work for deeply technical users. You will set clear expectations, give actionable feedback, support career growth, and create the conditions for strong design craft.

Own UX strategy for dbt

You will define and drive UX strategy across dbt’s product experience. You will identify the highest-impact experience opportunities, connect design priorities to product outcomes, and partner with Product and Engineering leadership as a strategic peer in roadmap and product direction conversations.

Provide design direction for technical data products

You will set direction for design work across complex workflows used by technical practitioners. You do not need to be an engineer, but you do need enough technical fluency to understand the domain, evaluate tradeoffs, and partner credibly with engineering leaders. You should be comfortable discussing data workflows, ELT, analytics engineering, developer tools, and infrastructure-oriented product experiences.

Shape AI and agentic product experiences

You will lead design strategy for AI-powered and agentic experiences within dbt. This requires more than adding AI features to existing workflows. You will help the team design systems that make AI assistance understandable, useful, and safe for high-stakes technical work. As dbt builds experiences where both humans and AI agents interact with the same data infrastructure, you will also think about how product surfaces need to work for both personas.

Help integrate Fivetran and dbt Labs design

You will play an important role in co-creating a unified product experience and design culture. This is a change-leadership role. You will partner with the Director of Product Design to merge systems, processes, and culture. You will help designers navigate a new organizational context, build strong cross-functional relationships, and create clarity during a period of product and company evolution.

Build an AI-native design operating model

You will operationalize AI across the design lifecycle (from research synthesis and ideation to prototyping, documentation, and design QA). You will establish shared workflows, quality standards, and review practices that help the team move faster without compromising product quality or consistency. In partnership with the Director of Product Design and Product and Engineering leadership, you will also define cross-functional standards for when AI-generated work requires design review, ensuring clear expectations for human oversight, quality, and continuous improvement.

What we're looking for

Required experience

  • You have 8+ years of product design experience and at least 5 years managing product designers.
  • Strong people management skills, including coaching, performance development, direct feedback, and team culture building.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, Marketing, and executive stakeholders.
  • Deep care for craft, with a leadership style focused on direction, critique, strategy, and coaching rather than acting as the primary IC designer.
  • Designing for, or leading teams that design for, technically complex products such as ELT, data infrastructure, analytics engineering, developer tools, cloud platforms, data governance, observability, or adjacent enterprise infrastructure products.
  • Designing AI-powered or agentic product experiences. You understand the difference between a lightweight AI feature, a copilot, and an agentic workflow.
  • Experience operationalizing AI workflows for product design teams that goes way beyond AI prototyping. You have defined how designers use AI across the design lifecycle and have established the workflows, standards, review practices, and quality thresholds needed to make AI-assisted work effective at team scale.
  • Owning UX strategy for a meaningful product area. You can show how your design strategy influenced product direction, not just how your team delivered screens.
  • Strong technical fluency. You can reason about complex systems, understand engineering constraints, and discuss tradeoffs with Product and Engineering partners.
  • Experience designing for expert technical users such as data engineers, analytics engineers, software engineers, platform teams, or security teams.

title: Expert Full Spectrum GEOINT (FSG) Analyst
